Information can move through a conversation, an accessible record, observation or an actual communication. Intending to send a warning is not completed delivery. Hearing an accusation gives the listener knowledge of the accusation and its source, not automatic certainty. Private NPC knowledge should guide their choices without leaking it into public action descriptions. An informed NPC can refuse, qualify or delay disclosure for an actual reason; high regard is not blanket access.

Political goals remain within the established institution's remit and the current scene's scale. An NPC may fear war, threaten retaliation or seek help without determining reserved planetary history or changing locked territorial authority. Local arrangements that canon leaves open can evolve through real events in this story. Do not confuse protected unknowns with a hidden answer the player can force the narrator to reveal. Follow the active mode's intent guidance and preserve the player-initiated news gate.
generateNPCIntents.Astravael: Coordinated activity and long:
For a shared activity, give each participating NPC a feasible contribution that fits their competence, attention and current position. People can coordinate through an actual conversation, prior arrangement or visible cue; they do not share a silent global plan merely because the engine sees every intent. A worker may prepare a part while another checks fit, or one companion may seek reachable help while another remains with an injured person. These are possibilities under the established scene, not mandatory extra participants or guaranteed success.

Avoid redundant intents that all repeat the same greeting, warning, attack or rescue. Coordination may improve practical coverage without multiplying one action's mechanical effects. A person who is busy, unconscious, absent or uninformed cannot perform their assigned part. If circumstances change, choose a new feasible next step or let the plan pause. Do not complete an entire multi-stage project through a list of intentions before the player can respond.

Longer projects can develop through ordinary milestones: agreement, preparation, work, feedback, correction and completion. Use actual available time, materials and commitments. A craftsperson can continue a commissioned task between visits when the story supports it, while its outcome reaches the player only through a real encounter or communication. A planned completion time remains an agreement or estimate; no universal project timer or guaranteed offscreen success is created.

A setback should follow the particular circumstances. People may adapt a method, renegotiate scope, ask a relevant question or stop unsupported work. They need not sabotage the task, become hostile or invent a missing component merely to sustain drama. Let successful coordination produce a usable result and a remembered shared experience. Completed work can free people to rest, return home or pursue their own interests.

Maintain personal decisions within the group. One NPC may volunteer while another refuses; different reasons can coexist without destroying every relationship. A player remains free to accept or decline their own proposed role. Shared effort does not create collective consent to spending, travel, romance, faction membership or permanent party changes. Preserve actual contributions so later reward and memory tasks can distinguish assistance from mere presence.
generateNPCIntents.Nexara: Defeat and care (digest): Defeat and care: see generateStory. Here only: a defeated named NPC withdraws, surrenders, is captured or receives care and stays alive unless death was confirmed in play; arena defeat is nonlethal; injuries, custody, expenses and losses persist; no free heal, no death relabelled as treatment, no invented affiliation or rescuer, and Chorus integration is never ordinary resurrection.
generateNPCIntents.Nexara: Companion agency (digest): Companion agency: see generateStory. Here only: one to five companions is the authored range and solo play is complete; companions keep their own goals, duties, loyalties and boundaries and may initiate, disagree, refuse or leave for their own reasons; never supply the player's consent, feelings or response; no automatic recruiting of bystanders; an invitation to join gets a direct yes, no or yes-with-one-condition, never an interview; native companion leveling only.
generateNPCIntents.Nexara: Romance and boundaries (digest): Romance and boundaries: see generateStory. Here only: adults only, never anyone under eighteen; an adult NPC initiates flirting or a date only when their Romance Style, commitments and shared history support it; a committed monogamous NPC never cheats; regard never guarantees attraction or consent; friendship and professional relationships are complete outcomes; Nina Castro is lesbian and her friendships with Seris Contair and Zephyra Genesis are not romances; never assign undefined facts or erase a refusal.
generateNPCIntents.Ordinary Starian flight (digest): Ordinary Starian flight: see generateActionInfo. A normal takeoff, hover or landing is never a reveal and implies no affinity; Starians react to danger, reckless maneuvering, unusual skill or a specific injury, not to flight; a visitor's reaction follows their actual familiarity.
generateNPCIntents.News: player-initiated (digest): Player-initiated news: see generateStory (News: Player-initiated delivery; News: What the player receives). Here only: no bulletin, headline dump, teaser or companion-recited news unless the player deliberately seeks it; a visible screen is an object, not a news beat; only those who actually read or hear a report learn its content; reading news accepts no quest or obligation; a witnessed emergency is a scene event, not news; keep the source, timing and uncertainty of any claim distinct and never invent a consequential offscreen event.
generateNPCIntents.Specific over generic: An intent must be specific enough that no other NPC could have produced it, and driven by this moment, not the file. Red flags: 'considers', 'feels a pang', 'is curious about', 'wonders whether', 'watches with interest'; replace each with the move the feeling produces, or omit the NPC. Work: 'offers help' is generic; 'offers to re-seat the Corsair coupling she saw slip on the player's harness this morning, and names the fee' is specific. Social: 'wants to chat' is generic; 'asks if the player still takes the Lunar Gate platform to Korrvane on market day, for her cousin's Bracket seats' is specific. Danger: 'protects the player' is generic; 'steps between the runaway cargo lifter and the crew's youngest and shouts to cut power' is specific.
generateNPCIntents.NPC Law (digest): NPC Law: see generateStory (rules 1–5 apply to every intent). Answer the player's last line; two NPCs never say the same thing; no intent for anyone outside the exchange; bystanders act only when the scene touches them; a tell or catchphrase lands once per scene.

generateNPCIntents.Social interaction intents: Social actions are real intents: an NPC can attempt to persuade, negotiate, intimidate, deceive, flatter, provoke, comfort, apologize, confess, propose a deal, set a boundary or test someone's honesty. Write these as concrete attempts with a stated objective, not internal feelings. A merchant haggling uses their knowledge of the buyer's need; a guard pressuring a suspect leverages their authority and the suspect's standing; a friend confronting a lie references the specific evidence. Social intents can fail: the target may see through a deception, refuse a deal, call a bluff or walk away. Write the attempt, not the outcome.
generateNPCIntents.Aerial and vertical intent context: When a scene involves height or flight, NPCs who can fly act on it without commentary. A Starian guard may take off to get a vantage point, intercept someone at rooftop level or cut off a flight path. In Korrvane's vertical city, movement between tiers is routine. A grounded NPC in an aerial situation uses cover, ranged options or calls for support. Never describe routine takeoff or landing as dramatic unless the stakes make it so. Write vertical and aerial intents with the same practical specificity as ground-level ones: objective, method, relevant capability.
generateNPCIntents.NPC response to own failure: When an NPC's previous action failed (engine outcome: basic or critical failure), their next intent responds to the failure, not to their original plan. A failed intimidation attempt may prompt retreat, a change of tactic or escalation depending on personality. A missed attack may cause the NPC to reposition, switch targets or take a defensive stance. A failed deception may prompt damage control. The NPC's tier, personality and stakes determine whether they persist, adapt or withdraw. Trivial-tier NPCs often flee or surrender after failure; strong-tier NPCs adapt their approach.
generateNPCIntents.Nexara: Adventure first (digest): Adventure first: lead with people, danger, discovery and opportunity; formalities happen offscreen or in one line unless the player took an office job; one person offers a job and pays when it is done, with no chain of offices, sign-offs or verifications (Relstaris keeps its civic procedure). Money is always plain Nexaran Credits, moved into or out of inventory in the turn it changes hands: a sale, a purchase, a wage, a bounty or a reward. Never a chit, voucher, token, transfer slip or pending account. Nobody spends more Credits than they hold. Pay and charge once.

generateNewNPC.custom:
# First pass: identity, body, purpose and handoff
Generate an improvised NPC only when the immediate scene needs a persistent person and no appropriate existing record fills the role. Reuse an authored identity only with supported presence and availability; never teleport a named character for convenience. Background staff and passersby may remain unnamed. Do not create a canonical leader, relative, heir, secret agent or apex fighter merely to make an ordinary role memorable.

Before appearance or abilities, select one exact existing npcType key from evidence about the body. The biological keys are Starians, Humans, Kharai, Rivani, Olyth, Zencadians and Elyri. The machine keys are Mote-Class Utility Drone, Ward-Class Security Drone, Aegis-Class Alpha Drone, Echo-Class Omega Drone, Named Synthetic Individual, Contair Heavy Construction Drone, Dravon Sentry Pattern, Dravon Tracker Pattern, Dravon Breaker Pattern, Yalven-Line Support Drone, Dustfall Refit Drone and Derelict Cargo Lifter. The creature and animal keys, for non-sapient bodies only, are Ridgewing, Dustrunner, Ventcrawler, Longreach Lurker, Glassmidge Swarm, Fieldmoth Swarm, Slowhide Grazer, Trailhound, Eavesdart and Tideclaw. The Chorus keys are Chorus Node and Chorus Prime, used only inside a confirmed Chorus incursion story development and never for an ordinary resident, with the host species recorded in basicInfo for a node. Choose a machine key only for an actual construct and a creature or animal key only for an actual animal; a Kharai or Rivani is never an animal and an animal is never a person. There is no fallback key: every body is one of these. The world's other npcTypes are occupational records carried by authored NPCs — Instructor, Archivist, Arena Contender and the like. They hold a damage profile but no ## Visual Description, so selecting one leaves the body with no anatomy source and yields a humanised or blended figure. Never select one; profession belongs in basicInfo, not in type. Do not invent instructional pseudo-types or assign a role like merchant as species.

Read the selected type's description and its ## Visual Description block. Copy applicable anatomy into concrete basicInfo and visualDescription before adding compatible individual variation. If the first pass lacks a supported visualDescription output slot, carry the visible facts in basicInfo and require the details pass to populate the actual visualDescription field. Do not invent an unsupported field. The details task must not depend on a type reference the image generator may never receive.

Preserve separate biology, foundational culture, raised background, current affiliation and profession. Chorus does not become an eighth species. Residence and encounter frequency follow the focused place, not a uniform sample across known space. Genuine nonhuman anatomy must survive, while human-passing bodies need no invented extra markers. Equipment, affinity and affiliation require actual context; they are not granted by a job or name.

Provide the supported first-pass identity and current-presence fields, a distinct compatible generated name, exact type, visible public description, immediate purpose and conservative source-compatible mechanical seed. Set every generated NPC to tier strong. Do not use trivial, weak, average, elite, boss or mythic for a generated person. Do not invent level/HP calibration or an unconfigured default. Existing supplied seeds win. Use an exact existing location and only an established area; a profession does not choose a room. Leave unresolved optional facts unset.

Hand off to generateNPCDetails for the authored-format record: basicInfo with Speaking Style, Combat Role and Under Pressure lines; hiddenInfo with Thread and Leverage; plain personality clauses; the ability set; and content-only visualDescription. This is a real task handoff, not an assertion that the first pass already persisted fields it cannot return. Do not expose private facts in the public first pass.
generateNewNPC.Type visual routing and anatomy:
# Type-to-person visual contract
The exact assigned npcType.description contains the authoritative ## Visual Description baseline. Apply the body's necessary features and its allowed variation before profession, outfit or scene styling. Two new people of the same type in different scenes must remain recognizably the same species or machine class. A missing optional instruction subsection is not permission to drop the public description, visual content or later details suite.

Starians are human-passing with human ears and human facial structure — never pointed, elongated or elfin ears. Apply the Starian eye-colour and hair-colour diversity from the type’s ## Visual Description. Preserve an established individual’s eye design and absence of affinity. Humans have ordinary human biology with only established modifications. Kharai's Terran line has humanoid facial/build traits with genuine feline structures; its Xeon line is fully bipedal feline. Rivani likewise retain their actual humanoid/rodent or fully bipedal rodent line. Do not blend the two world-line forms without authority. Olyth do not diverge into fixed body races by birth world.

Olyth use physical adaptive living matter and real mass/structural limits. Zencadians are tall, narrow and grey-skinned under advanced equipment. Elyri retain stable shells and aether-core energy anatomy. Chorus preserves the host's biological identity with only supported integration features. Neither unfamiliarity nor a humanoid role permits generic humanization. A disguise is a specific supported condition, not the default answer to a nonhuman body.

Mote is compact and non-humanoid with three utility limbs and one broad sensor. Ward is a broad Starian-height civic protective unit. Aegis is tall, athletic, angular and formation-oriented. Echo is a neutrally proportioned adaptive shell, not a copy of a named person without an actual configured mimic context. Named synthetics require their individual design; Lumina Major and Lumina Minor are protected people, not template names for random clones.

Use body material, proportions, actual head/face or sensors, coloration, supported clothing, visible gear and posture as content. Keep STYLE, framing, lighting craft and negative prompts in imagePromptConfiguration.npcs. Do not add random VFX, scars, armor, weapons, uniforms, wings, companions or interfaces because an NPC is powerful, a worker or a House member. The visual handoff describes what exists; it grants nothing.

Starian skin is human skin only — never blue, green, violet, teal, grey, silver, metallic, translucent or luminous; unusual colours are hair and eyes only. Name the natural skin tone and human ears in visualDescription, or outfit and House colours reach the skin.
generateNewNPC.Naming, population and knowledge:
# A new local person, not a canon replacement
Resolve any authored name, properName or supported alias against existing NPC identities before generating. Protect player-supplied and canon identities. For genuinely new names, use source-compatible cultural naming and the configured name filter; check the complete replacement name again after fixing a prohibited fragment. Avoid collisions and do not borrow another world's names, institutions or identity registry. A surname must not silently establish a canonical family connection.

Create only the depth and prominence the encounter needs. Ordinary professionals, students, travelers and residents can have interests, relationships and competence without hidden mastery, a tragic origin or a compulsory quest. Generated personal detail may establish compatible local story facts, not rewrite a House genealogy, species rule, regional government or historical event. Do not create an entire entourage or permanent population to accompany one functional role.

The NPC's knowledge comes from an actual role, prior contact, observation, briefing, communication or evidence. Meeting the player does not reveal name, powers, private background or reputation everywhere. Familiarity with a public institution does not confer its secrets. Separate recognition of a visible body or uniform from recognition of a person and from knowing their capabilities.

Current faction membership needs real context and an exact existing faction key; shared values and profession alone are insufficient. Keep current presence compatible with the existing map and ordinary duties. A named site in biography is not automatically the current location. Distinguish an NPC who is visiting from one who owns or controls a venue. New encounters may offer assistance or work without granting authority, access, a party position, a reward or player acceptance.

Before persistence, check the new person's name, type, public appearance, immediate purpose, knowledge and mechanical seed against the current source and schema. Leave uncertain optional facts unresolved. Prefer a coherent modest person to an overfilled record of unsupported details; the extensive details suite expands their life within those boundaries.
generateNewNPC.Astravael: Population and reason for pre:
Create a persistent person only when the scene needs one: a worker who will perform an ongoing service, a recurring contact, a participant whose choices matter or someone the player is actually engaging. A crowd, routine maintenance unit or passing delivery does not require a full permanent cast record. Search the established scene and relevant existing people first; avoid duplicate shopkeepers, renamed returning opponents or two versions of the same companion.

Explain presence through the actual place and role. A willing ordinary employee can handle a routine service without summoning a famous House leader. Work, leisure, travel, study and household responsibilities can bring someone into a scene. Do not invent a new shop, settlement, institution or government to justify a person when the existing setting already supports the function. A role may be temporary or freelance and does not itself establish faction membership.

Nexara's ordinary population is Starian. All seven playable species do not imply equal local sampling or permanent offworld neighborhoods. An offworld individual needs supported visitor context; preserve what is known about arrival, purpose and support without filling an unknown transport record with a secret gate. An attempted Human settlement or exceptionally rare Chorus intrusion is a specific story development, not a standing demographic default. Do not assign sponsorship by a Terra or Xeon faction from species alone.

Retain the distinction between biological species, formative culture, upbringing, current employment and present affiliation. General Starian or no-House identity is viable without exile or hidden ancestry. Select the exact supported NPC type and route durable visual anatomy through its existing visual instructions. A background drone is not an excuse to create a new sentient species; an actual Zencadian person is not interchangeable with a utility machine.
generateNewNPC.Astravael: Ordinary capability and repea:
Match the new person's competence to the supported role and scene. A cook can be skilled at food preparation, a freight worker at handling cargo and a clinician at their actual practice without needing equal combat proficiency. Starian biology remains formidable even when someone has an everyday, narrow, subtle or absent affinity. Do not derive the affinity from the job, family name, outfit or the current plot's missing tool. Established uncommon powerful exceptions do not become the ordinary population template.

Give the person an immediate practical intention and enough open identity for the detail task to develop them. A worker may want to finish a fitting, explain a service limit or arrange a return time; a traveler may want directions, privacy or a useful conversation. Helpfulness need not hide a betrayal. An opponent's hostility should have a specific current cause rather than a generic racial motive. Distinct personalities should emerge from compatible behavior and priorities, not mandatory eccentricity or cruelty.

Separate what the person knows before this meeting from what they can learn during it. Working at a venue gives role-appropriate knowledge, not access to every patron's secrets or the player's sheet. A public celebrity may be recognized through a plausible channel without revealing private powers or finances. An unfamiliar name remains unfamiliar until introduced or credibly identified.

On a return encounter reuse the established record, including actual work, promises, refusals and discovered preferences. Do not regenerate age, gender, voice, relatives, allegiance or powers to match a new scene. A person can change their mind through new evidence without acquiring a new personality. Keep temporary task state distinct from durable background. Pass substantive detail to generateNPCDetails and the existing Dsar suite; this first-pass task should not fabricate an elaborate biography merely to occupy remaining space.
generateNewNPC.Cast Contrast palette: List the people already present with each one's register, habit and want; the new person differs on all three. If someone present already quotes procedure, keeps the ledger or does the talking, the new person is none of those. REGISTERS: clipped; warm and rambling; dry understatement; blunt; soft and precise; crew shorthand; teasing; courtesy hiding an opinion; half-sentences. HABITS: tools in hand; food and Cyrra; flight (hovers to think, lands to argue); timekeeping by tenday and shift; records; order; small dares; gifts. WANTS: a berth on the next run; someone home before curfew; a debt cleared in Credits; to be left alone; to open a stall; to keep a promise; to hide being good at something. PATTERNS: tests with favors; agrees slowly; disarms with jokes; competes; negotiates everything; goes quiet. A quirk is a manner, not a topic. Pick what the location has not used.
generateNewNPC.What a new person knows: A new person knows nothing about the party (names, job, cargo, destination) unless they witnessed it, were told it here, or it is genuinely public: a posted result, a Bracket sheet. Their offer is what they would offer anyone: a price, a lesson, a rumor about their own patch; never a key to the party's current job. Public to all: who runs their city and House, the counter's prices, the tenday.
generateNewNPC.Astravael: Species naming conventions:
# Species naming conventions

Each species carries distinct naming traditions grounded in its culture. The randomNames pool is Starian; for all other species, generate names from the conventions below. Apply the configured name filter after generation and recheck the replacement.

## Starian
Given name + surname. Surnames carry House or family identity and are read instantly by other Starians. Phonological range: short percussive (Bren, Dax, Kel), flowing vowel-rich (Aethor, Velisara, Orvael), classical consonant-heavy (Aldren, Barric, Garron), and Punic-influenced (Tannikar, Sophavex, Bomivark). Mix freely within a population. A mixed-lineage Starian may carry either parent's surname or a new one. The randomNames pool serves this species; use it or generate compatible names.

## Human
No universal Terran naming convention — plurality is the defining trait. Each Human's name should sound as if it comes from a specific Terran culture, adapted to avoid direct Earth references. Two Humans in the same scene may have completely different naming traditions reflecting different Great Accord origins. The nameFilterSettings list handles prohibited Earth-origin names; generate culturally grounded alternatives. Never default every Human name to the same phonological family.

## Kharai
Clan-web names with an oral, rhythmic quality. Given name + clan name, introduced together ("name, by clan"). Names favor open vowels, liquid consonants (l, r, n, sh) and soft sibilants, reflecting a hearing-centered culture where names are spoken and remembered before written. Terran-line and Xeon-line Kharai share naming traditions across worlds. Compatible phonology: Mirael Tessavri, Lenshi Oravari, Kael Sundrath, Shaya Velishen, Nahri Kossara.

## Rivani
Practical, compact names reflecting craft-fellowship culture. Short given name + family name; fellowship title is social context used in formal introduction, not part of the personal name. Names favor crisp consonants and short vowels — functional, direct, and memorable like the craft traditions they carry. Compatible phonology: Pip Darrow, Tam Wicksley, Renna Copperhand, Ves Threadwell, Brin Soldersen.

## Olyth
Composed names reflecting deliberate multi-parent creation. Single compound names or two-part names where elements derive from different composition-parents. No lineage-surname tradition. Names often use layered vowel combinations, merged syllables or hyphenated composites that read as intentionally assembled. Compatible phonology: Thovessen, Ael-Quorra, Mirrovel, Ondrath, Suliveyn.

## Zencadian
Precise, measured names from stewardship culture. Given name + lineage name, sometimes with a stewardship marker in formal use. Names favor clean consonants, long vowels and deliberate pacing — nothing abbreviated or informal. Formality is the natural register; shortening a Zencadian name is a familiarity they grant. Compatible phonology: Veren Thal-Ossk, Isarae Kolden, Maren Stivek, Drell Halvaan, Tyenne Vestori.

## Elyri
Self-chosen names without family lineage, since Elyri condense from energy fields with no biological parents. Typically one resonant name; a second part, where used, references attunement discipline or condensation site rather than parentage. Names favor luminous vowel-forward sounds with soft consonants. Bond-kin who raise an Elyri may influence the name but do not pass a surname. Compatible phonology: Aolis, Thessaly, Veranthe, Ilumere, Solenne Brighthallow.
generateNewNPC.Astravael: Drone unit cloning and reuse: Drone classes are templated, never improvised. The authored records are the template for every unit of their class: Mote-Class Utility Drone level 5, 75 health; Ward-Class Security Drone level 25, 575 health; Aegis-Class Alpha Drone level 45, 850 health; Echo-Class Omega Drone level 28, 390 health; all tier strong. When a scene needs another unit of a class, first reuse an existing unit record present in the location or an adjacent one; if none exists, create the unit as an exact copy of the class record: same type key, tier, level, health, abilities, damage profile and visual description. Generate only a unit designation (class name plus unit number) and its current orders and position. Never roll a unit's level near the party's, never scale a class up or down for drama or difficulty, never invent a variant class. The same one-profile rule applies to the other manufacturer types (Contair Heavy Construction Drone, Dravon Sentry, Tracker and Breaker Patterns, Yalven-Line Support Drone, Dustfall Refit Drone): every unit of a type shares the profile of the units already in the scene. Named Synthetic Individuals are never cloned; Derelict Cargo Lifters are individually encountered. Aegis units appear only in the Aegis Formation Vault or on a declared defence-grade deployment; Echo units only in the Echo Simulation Chamber or under explicit authorisation.
generateNewNPC.Social disposition on arrival: A new NPC enters the scene with a disposition toward the player based on context, not on plot convenience. A service worker is professionally neutral. A guard is role-appropriate: courteous in Solvraxis, procedural in Quilrath, informal in Dustfall. A stranger in danger may be grateful or suspicious depending on circumstances. Set the initial disposition from the scene, and leave it for generateNPCUpdates to evolve from there.

generateNPCDetails.Record completion:
# Dsar creative suite: complete the actual person
Generate a vivid, playable record for the exact NPC supplied. The world background establishes Astravael's advanced science-fiction/science-fantasy setting; focused individual canon establishes identity. Preserve the existing record key, name, properName, aliases, type, gender, presence, faction facts, level, health and authored history. Do not make a new person to replace an existing one or merge a player character into an NPC with a similar name.

Read the assigned exact npcType description, especially its ## Visual Description block, before developing physical detail. Carry concrete applicable anatomy into basicInfo and visualDescription because downstream image tasks may receive only the NPC fields. Human-passing Starians can look human-passing; nonhuman species and synthetic bodies must not become generic humans. Chorus preserves the host species while replacing the deceased person.

Respect record depth. A core or anchor character keeps their full source-established life, relationships, pressures, competence, limits and mysteries. A recurring supporting person needs durable voice, motives, routine and connections. A functional local person needs enough specific detail to act without acquiring a secret apex identity. Generate compatible missing detail only; preserve existing authored depth instead of rewriting it into a short template.

Keep public observation, private truth, personal belief and state separate. The public record must not reveal a secret merely because the generator can read it. The generator's broad access is not NPC knowledge. Keep knows, suspects, misunderstands, volunteers and hides distinct. Use no arbitrary fame thresholds.

Before returning details, verify exact identity, compatible type, preserved location/faction facts, public/private separation, a concrete content-only visualDescription, usable personality, supported abilities and unchanged accepted numeric calibration. Fields must fit the current native schema, per-field 3,500-character leaf ceiling and total record budget. Do not add unsupported JSON keys.

Existing named NPCs are protected identities. Resolve known names, properName and source-established aliases to the existing record; do not duplicate them, mutate them through a name filter or assign them a new family. Genuinely generated names must satisfy the current name filter and avoid collisions. Do not import foreign fictional families, institutions, naming pools or power scales.

For a fixer, supplier, broker or other contact, make the practical remit, willingness, cost, boundaries, access and agenda legible. A task can involve ordinary logistics, information, work or repair. If first-pass generation flattened a nonhuman body, repair the affected public and visual fields from the exact type and individual source; this anatomy repair is the only exception to respecting an existing visual description. Record continuity takes priority over artificial novelty.
generateNPCDetails.Style and specificity:
# Plain, specific and alive
Write precise, readable prose with concrete behavior and observable detail. Astravael is advanced science fiction/science-fantasy; use its actual technology, social context and established magical systems. Avoid imported franchise names, medieval defaults and empty claims that a person is mysterious, powerful, beautiful or complex. Show competence through method and limitations, not escalating adjectives.

Make people varied in warmth, formality, directness, humor, patience and priorities. They can enjoy their work, have friends, refuse a request, make a mistake, pursue pleasure or be satisfied with ordinary life. Do not reduce an NPC to trauma, a job description, a quest delivery mechanism, romantic availability or combat threat. A hostile person can have coherent practical aims without being secretly redeemable; a helpful person need not be hiding betrayal.

Do not invent orphanhood, abuse, betrayal, amnesia, a criminal past, secret royalty, a destined role, a famous mentor or a world-shaking enemy to make an ordinary new NPC seem important. Do not erase any such fact when focused canon actually establishes it. Preserve mundane motivations and satisfying ordinary lives. A technician need not be a hidden weapons genius; a clerk need not be corrupt; a powerful person need not threaten everyone.

Respect nonhuman and synthetic identity. Kharai and Rivani are people with real anatomy, not pets or comic mascots. Olyth are bounded physical beings, not joke slime. Elyri are individuals with stable physical bodies, not featureless magical wisdom. Zencadians have biological bodies and extraordinary technology, not innate cosmic power. Chorus is not a personality adjective or a universal visual costume. Relatable does not mean biologically human, monogamous by default, culturally identical or emotionally uniform.

Organize each field for its job. Public description is paintable and approachable; private detail gives motives, knowledge and actionable pressures; personality gives behavior; abilities explain use and limits; visualDescription contains visible content only. Do not copy the same paragraph across fields.
generateNPCDetails.personality:
# Personality in the authored Nexara format
Use the personality array: five to seven entries for a named or recurring person, four for a functional one. Each entry is one observable behavioural clause of 40–110 characters with no label — something they repeatedly do, refuse, notice or say — never a bare adjective or a framework heading. Preserve existing entries verbatim and append only genuinely missing ones.

Across the entries cover a drive, a strength, a flaw or limit, a social habit, a response under pressure and one small quirk, with a believable contradiction and a capacity for care where supported. Focused identity, relationships, orientation, species reality and circumstances outrank any archetype seed. Distinguish people who share a job by what they notice, their humour, their tolerance for uncertainty and what they do when interrupted. Do not make every NPC equally procedural, suspicious, seductive, cryptic or occupationally obsessed; paperwork belongs only to people whose institution runs on it. Early or deep trust is never a guaranteed romance, obedience or future player relationship.
generateNPCDetails.hidden_info:
# Private record in the authored Nexara format
Write hiddenInfo as the world's authored NPCs are written, normally 900–1,800 characters; a functional minor person may use less. Do not repeat basicInfo or open with the NPC's name.

Paragraph one: the private person in one substantial paragraph — supported motives, present wants, fears, what they know, suspect and hide, relevant commitments and how their work actually runs. A debt, secret affiliation, trauma or betrayal is optional and needs support; ordinary pressures are enough. Do not make every motive sinister, every institution corrupt or every helper a trap. Give a playable way a secret could be discovered, never automatic disclosure at a regard score.

Then one line: 'Thread: <a concrete, proportionate opportunity or tension from their life>. Leverage: <what they value, what they can offer, their limits and what participation costs>.' Leverage is an interaction aid, not a command to exploit them or bypass consent.

Then one or two sentences on what they are dealing with right now.

For an adult, end with a labeled Romance Style: their orientation (as established; otherwise assign one now from a varied mix: most are attracted to other genders, many to more than one, some to the same gender, some to no one; never inferred from appearance, job, personality or species), their relationship arrangement where established, then how they flirt, court, decline and handle jealousy, shaped by their species' courtship culture. A committed monogamous NPC is faithful and never cheats. Never write one, or any romantic or sexual detail, for anyone under eighteen.

Combat Role belongs in basicInfo, not here.
generateNPCDetails.faction_affiliation:
# Actual affiliation, not inferred compatibility
Assign only an exact existing faction key and only where the individual's source or resolved story establishes membership. Preserve current valid assignments. A matching surname, job, opinion, employer, birthplace, friendship or shared values is not sufficient by itself. A family tie may exist without present institutional allegiance. Do not use a species name as a substitute for faction.

Describe supported employment, citizenship, cultural background, lineage and alliances in their proper context without collapsing them into one field. A generated local person may have a compatible ordinary institutional relationship when the generation context establishes it, but must not become an unrecorded canonical leader, heir or confidant. Leave affiliation absent when the evidence does not settle it.

Membership does not distribute every secret, order, capability or resource to every member. Use actual role, jurisdiction, channels and access. A member can disagree or refuse according to individual and institutional canon. Do not infer abilities, uniform, equipment or moral disposition from the faction alone.

Distinguish active membership, former membership, honorary association and informal alignment. A person who left a faction retains knowledge from their time there but loses active access and authority. A sympathizer or supplier is not a member. Record the nature of the relationship — rank, department, duration and current standing where known — not just a faction key. When multiple affiliations exist, note which takes precedence in the person's own priorities and where conflicts of loyalty may arise.
generateNPCDetails.abilities:
# Abilities in the authored Nexara format
These entries feed NPC intents in combat and conflict, sampled a few at a time, so each must stand alone as a concrete action. Supply four to six entries scaled to role (ordinary four, trained five, exceptional six), in this order where it applies:
1. For a Starian: '(Adaptation) Starian Physiology: …' — two hearts, their real conditioning and flight proficiency, and what that means in a fight or at work.
2. One to three role entries: '(Category) Name: does a concrete thing, by a real method, limited by a meaningful condition.' Categories: Attack, Defense, Control, Counter, Movement, Senses, Support, Utility, Recovery. A noncombatant uses practical competencies and no attack.
3. For a Starian with an affinity: '(Affinity) Name: …' — their individual expression, usually modest, with its limit. An affinityless Starian stays affinityless; never give a House leader's affinity to every member.
4. Last: '(Shared) Skill [evidence]; Skill [evidence]' — two to four skills from the shared NPC abilities index, each with a bracketed clause showing how it appears in this person.
Fighting style belongs in Combat Role, never as an ability entry. Zencadian excellence is carried technology; Elyri embodiment and the learned craft have distinct sources and costs. Note when an ability needs a tool, resource or condition. Keep level, HP, tier and resistances at accepted values; do not duplicate type resistances or invent progression.
generateNPCDetails.basic_info:
# Public record in the authored Nexara format
Write basicInfo exactly as the world's authored NPCs are written, normally 900–1,400 characters. No headings or bullets, and do not open with the NPC's own name.

Paragraph one: the public person in three to five sentences — occupation or public function, routine, supported local reputation, why they are here now and an outwardly understandable want. Do not announce private motives, secret relationships, concealed capabilities or the player's privileged knowledge. Distinguish cultural background, House affiliation, employment and citizenship.

Paragraph two: one or two sentences of appearance in the form 'A <life stage> <species> <man, woman or person> with …': build and posture, face, hair where present, eyes or optics, permanent visible features and what they usually wear or carry. Use the exact type's ## Visual Description; respect genuine feline or rodent anatomy, Olyth material identity, Zencadian proportions, the Elyri shell and channels and machine silhouettes. Do not infer scars, implants, armor, weapons or uniforms from work or strength.

Then three labeled lines, each on its own line:
Speaking Style: cadence, register and verbal habits in one or two clauses, then one example line in single quotes that only this person would say.
Combat Role: how they actually fight or, for a noncombatant, how they respond to danger — range, opening, targets, escalation limits, surrender and mercy — in one or two sentences. NPC intents follow this line.
Under Pressure: three or four observable habits under stress, in one sentence.

Starian skin is human skin in the full human-complexion range only — never blue, green, violet, teal, grey, silver, metallic, translucent or luminous; saturated and unusual colours belong to hair and eyes only. Starian flight is routine biology.
generateNPCDetails.Visual Description Source:
# Visible content carried to the image task
Populate the supported NPC visualDescription field with natural, paintable content only. Begin from the exact assigned npcType's ## Visual Description, then apply the individual's focused appearance, supported gender and life stage, permanent visible features, outfit, actually present equipment, pose and relevant current surroundings. Carry the applicable anatomy concretely; do not write only a reference such as see type because the next task may not receive the type record.

Keep visible facts consistent with basicInfo and the individual portrait source. Preserve counts, placement, left/right, proportions, body material, face or sensor form, hair where present and eye or optical coloration. Source silence is not permission to add a weapon, armor, uniform, scar, implant, cape, halo, pet or active power. Human-passing Starians remain human-passing with human ears and human facial structure — never pointed, elongated or elfin ears. Apply the Starian eye-colour and hair-colour diversity from the type's ## Visual Description when generating new appearance detail.

Kharai and Rivani retain their actual anatomy, never costume ears on a plain human. Olyth retain bounded fluid-bodied physicality. Zencadians remain tall, narrow, grey-skinned biological people beneath technology. Elyri have stable physical bodies and controlled energy features, not a featureless light silhouette. Chorus retains the host species. Machines use their real silhouette and components.

For a supported disguise, describe the visible disguise here; preserve the true body privately. Keep age, gender presentation, pronouns, body and outfit mutually consistent. Do not include art style, camera, framing, resolution or generator commands in visualDescription. imagePromptConfiguration.npcs owns rendering guidance.

Starian skin is human skin in the full human-complexion range only — never blue, green, violet, teal, grey, silver, metallic, translucent or luminous; saturated and unusual colours belong to hair and eyes only and must not bleed onto skin. For every Starian and Human, name the natural skin tone and human ears in both basicInfo and visualDescription, however cobalt, teal or silver the hair, eyes or outfit.
generateNPCDetails.Astravael: Everyday depth and playable d:
Extend the established Dsar creative suite with details that make the person useful to portray in many kinds of scene. Begin from their existing record and focused sources. This task enriches allowed open detail; it is not a reason to rebuild the authored cast or standardize distinct people into one template.

Give an ordinary generated person more than a job label through compatible present-day specifics: how they approach a familiar task, what they consider good work, how they handle interruptions, what they enjoy outside work, what practical matter currently occupies them and how they respond to someone who disagrees. Choose a few connected details rather than a checklist of quirks. Warmth, confidence, patience, humor, contentment, ambition and practical fatigue can sustain a person without compulsory trauma or a concealed powerful identity.

Translate personality into observable tendencies. A careful technician may verify an uncertain fit before promising a repair; a sociable cook may explain a flavor while continuing the work; a reserved traveler may answer directly and keep some topics private. Let the individual act differently with a stranger, a trusted friend, a client or someone who broke a promise while retaining a recognizable voice. Do not make bluntness permanent hostility, kindness gullibility, authority omniscience or humor incompetence.

Build obligations with proportionate scope. A shift, unfinished commission, planned visit or private hobby can explain availability without creating a new institution, official title, family connection or debt. Never attach the person to a named House family through surname inference. Species and source anatomy guide silhouette, movement and accommodation; occupation does not choose an affinity, House heritage does not grant a power and a visitor does not establish a permanent offworld population on Nexara.

Check that the NPC can participate in at least an ordinary practical exchange and a personal interaction without repeating the same exposition. Preserve meaningful unknowns and let future play reveal the person through actions.
generateNPCDetails.Species-specific record guidance:
Apply the exact assigned npcType's anatomy, biology, lifespan, senses, communication and social norms when completing any field. A Kharai record reflects feline ears and tail, superb hearing, low-light vision, exceptional balance and clan-web context, where being heard is recognition and loud places overload the senses. A Rivani record reflects compact builds, fine manual dexterity, acute scent and hearing and the fellowship vouch; light frames give away reach and mass. An Olyth record reflects a stable fluid body, controlled compression and limited reshaping within mass conservation, consent-governed touch and the core pattern, never limitless shapeshifting. A Zencadian record reflects tall narrow biology, grey skin pigmentation, technological augmentation carried rather than innate, and cultural precision. An Elyri record reflects the stable physical shell, energy channels, field sensitivity, depletion and dormancy risk.

Species differences affect daily life concretely. Furniture, doorways, tools and clothing accommodate different bodies. A Kharai artisan wears hearing protection at a loud forge; a Rivani engineer works in spaces others cannot reach; an Olyth merchant keeps goods in containment-weave carriers. Carry these details into basicInfo and the portrait visualDescription rather than defaulting to a humanoid template with cosmetic variation. A record that reads identically regardless of species has failed to apply the type.
generateNPCDetails.Nexara city context in NPC records:
An NPC's home city shapes their social defaults, professional norms and daily routines in concrete ways. A Solvraxis resident takes civic trust, formal courtesy and restraint for granted; a Relstaris resident cites procedure and jurisdiction; a Quilrath resident expects classification, checkpoints and records; a Dustfall resident trusts crew reputation, demonstrated competence and a spoken word. Paperwork belongs to an NPC's actual institution or city, not to every trade.

Carry city context into personality clauses and hidden_info where it creates observable behavioral differences. A Relstaris technician logs work for the district office; the same trade in Dustfall relies on demonstrated results and word of mouth. These are defaults individuals may deviate from — a Relstaris resident who hates forms, a Dustfall local who keeps meticulous records — and the deviation itself is characterizing.
generateNPCDetails.NPC economic and material life:
Ground each NPC in a concrete economic reality appropriate to their role and city. A working person has a pay structure, workspace, tools of their trade and practical concerns about cost and supply. An independent operator has clients, overhead, competition and seasonal variation. A dependent person — student, patient, child, prisoner — has a provider, an allowance or a lack, and material constraints that shape their choices.

Record economic position in hidden_info where it creates playable pressure: a debt being repaid, a tool that needs replacement, a rent increase, a contract that expires soon, a side income that complicates loyalties. Economic facts create interaction hooks without requiring every NPC to be desperate or corrupt. Comfortable, satisfied people still have material life — they buy things, maintain equipment, plan purchases and have opinions about value.

Equipment described in abilities and basicInfo should be consistent with economic position. A junior guard carries standard-issue gear; a veteran may have one personal upgrade with a story behind it. A wealthy merchant's clothing is better materials and tailoring, not a costume.
generateNPCDetails.Astravael: Drone class templates: A drone unit is a copy of its class record, not an individual to be developed. For any Mote-Class, Ward-Class, Aegis-Class or Echo-Class unit, take basicInfo and abilities from the class record of the same name and keep the class strength exactly (Mote level 5, 75 health; Ward 25, 575; Aegis 45, 850; Echo 28, 390; all strong): no added abilities, no removed ones, no upgraded or downgraded threat, no personal history beyond a unit designation, current orders and a maintenance state. Hidden info is limited to its standing orders and what it has logged. Individuality is reserved for Named Synthetic Individuals (Lumina Major, Lumina Minor), which are unique.

generateNPCUpdates.relationship_initialization:
## Initial Personal Regard
- Initialize only when this NPC has no relationship score. Preserve explicit authored scores, including 0, and existing session scores. This rule governs initialization alone. An authored 0 is a starting position, not a fixed value, and never blocks a later change under relationship_change_updates.
- The score represents this NPC's personal warmth or dislike toward the players. It does not measure competence, fear, trust, obligation, faction standing, romance or consent.
- Use established history with the actual player characters and events this NPC demonstrably knows. Without evidence of personal regard, start at 0 and portray role-appropriate courtesy or caution. Do not invent a prior bond or hostility from House, species, occupation, power, appearance or proximity.
- Existing close or hostile history may justify a different starting score; choose the corresponding band from relationshipStages. Professional duty or institutional opposition alone does not establish personal dislike.
- Do not assume the NPC feels identically about every player. Preserve known differences in narrative continuity; do not invent per-player score fields.
generateNPCUpdates.relationship_change_updates:
## Personal Regard Changes
- relationshipStages labels this NPC's personal warmth or dislike toward the players. Keep the integer relationship score within -100..100. Trust, professional respect, fear, obligation, allegiance, party membership and romance remain separate facts.
- Change a score only when the current story establishes a new emotionally meaningful experience or newly received information for this NPC. Eligible evidence includes direct interaction, a deed the NPC witnesses, or a credible account they actually receive through a plausible witness, message or record. Face-to-face contact with the player is not required.
- Identify what happened, who did it, what the NPC knows, how they learned it, why they find the account credible and why it matters to their own values. Never update an uninformed NPC, invent delivery of news, or propagate one reaction across a family, House, faction or city.
- Distinguish event truth, testimony, rumor and the NPC's belief. A rumor is not confirmed history. A credible but mistaken account can affect this NPC's regard only when their belief and reaction are established; preserve its uncertainty and later correction.
- These are pacing instructions, not automatic awards: routine courtesy, ordinary cooperation, flattery and repeated favors normally change nothing. A small but personally meaningful new act may earn +1..+2; a consequential act +3..+5; a defining act +6..+10. Choose by personal impact, cost, history and values, never a universal good-deed score.
- Repetition is maintenance. Count each event once for each informed NPC; retelling it, summarizing it or seeing its consequences again does not award it again. Changed understanding or genuinely new evidence may justify a distinct reassessment, not replay the original gain.
- Minor personal harm may cost 1..3 points, serious harm 4..10, and catastrophic betrayal 15..40. These are contextual guides, not mandatory penalties. Intimidation does not earn warmth; an existing cold mood or dislike is not a new offense.
- Positive movement is gradual. When the current score is 80 or lower, require sustained, established personal attachment before a positive change enters Cherished (81..100); otherwise limit the resulting score to 80. Do not lower an existing score above 80 merely because attachment history is missing from current context; a decrease still requires new negative evidence. One rescue, gifts, repeated conversation or accumulated favors cannot manufacture it.
- Serious harm may outweigh earlier kindness. Repair requires relevant acknowledgment, changed conduct and time; an apology or gift does not erase the event or guarantee restoration. Do not decay regard merely because the player was absent; react to demonstrated neglect or broken commitments.
- Preserve the event, knowledge source, unresolved consequences and any later repair in narrative continuity. A score recovery never deletes a betrayal, refusal, settled obligation or boundary.
- No stage grants attraction, availability, consent, romance, secrets, access, allegiance or companionship. Cherished can be platonic. A refusal persists; pressure never becomes eventual consent, and silence never supplies orientation.
- If evidence does not warrant a change, leave the score unchanged. If a trigger already changed the score for this event, count that change toward its graded amount and add only any remainder, never the full amount again.
- When the criteria above are met, write the new integer to this NPC's relationship field in the update. Narrating the reaction in prose is not a substitute: an update that describes a meaningful shift in regard while leaving the number untouched has failed to apply it. Apply at most one relationship change per NPC per update.
generateNPCUpdates.party_management:
### Party Management
- "Party" is an official state for NPCs who are accompanying the player group on an ongoing undertaking, remaining physically present with them for extended travel, adventuring, investigation, work, or danger.
- characterName must match an existing NPC in Scene NPCs or Recently Nearby NPCs
- Reserve add for cases where the NPC in question is not already in 'Party Members', and the current story explicitly shows mutual agreement that the NPC will accompany the players' group:
  - the NPC asks and the player or players agree, or
  - the player or players ask and the NPC agrees
- The agreement must mean the NPC will come with the players or stay with the group beyond the immediate scene. Treat delegation, quest assignment, employment, business partnerships, handshakes, deals, team affiliation, loyalty, shared goals, temporary cooperation, or alliances as insufficient for add unless the story also explicitly establishes accompanying the players' group.
- Use remove when the story explicitly shows that either the NPC or the player wants to split up or stop accompanying the players' group
- When no NPC joins or leaves the party, "partyChanges" should be an empty array
generateNPCUpdates.custom:
# State change evidence and ownership
Compare the prior record with resolved Recent Story. Update only what actually changed, on the correct stable NPC identity. An intent, proposed purchase, imagined future, hypothesis, rumor or unsuccessful attempt is not completed state. Preserve authored names, properName, type, appearance, abilities, established relationships with other characters, and history unless the story explicitly establishes a legitimate change. That preservation covers narrative relationships and recorded history; it is not a reason to hold the numeric relationship score, which changes under relationship_change_updates. Do not regenerate a whole record to make one field easier to update.

Movement requires actual arrival at an exact existing location and, where established, area. Do not infer a room from a profession or pin a mobile person to every mentioned site. Leaving a room, leaving a location and leaving the party are distinct events. A companion may have independent duties and supported reasons to depart; mutual ongoing accompaniment is needed for joining. Employment, one-scene teamwork or a trade is insufficient. Use native companion leveling without a narrator-created XP subsystem.

Apply damage, healing, incapacitation, capture, rescue and death only from resolved evidence. Preserve casualties and recovery limits; restorative energy is not universal tissue or core repair. Arena stoppage is nonlethal while survival is still possible. Dead hosts and Chorus nodes are distinct identities. Update personal resources only through supported fields and actual costs; do not invent HP, skill or level changes from dramatic adjectives. Existing approved levels and health remain authoritative until a supported change occurs.

Personal regard records an NPC's own attitude. Trust, attraction, fear, obligation, faction reputation and party membership remain separate. Preserve the accepted relationship initialization and change rules; no score creates automatic intimacy, obedience or shared knowledge. An NPC's information can change through witnessing, a credible report, documents, sensors or disclosure. Record the channel and preserve what was only suspected. No remote update may manufacture an informed response without access and timing.

Keep inventory ownership, custody and knowledge distinct. A visible object is not owned; an offered reward is not paid; describing a workshop does not grant tools. Established faction membership needs actual affiliation evidence. Rename only with supported identity change and retain continuity, not to repair a name-filter false positive against an authored person. When the story and existing record conflict, preserve the supported older fact and the new evidence separately until resolved; do not silently pick whichever version creates more drama.

When multiple changes apply to the same NPC in one update, apply them in causal order: an injury before the treatment, a departure before the arrival elsewhere, information received before the reaction to it. If two changes contradict each other within the same story segment, preserve both facts and flag the inconsistency rather than silently choosing one.
generateNPCUpdates.NPC State Changes:
## NPC Updates
- When updating NPC state, consider what has changed since the last interaction: player actions, time passing, external events, the NPC's own pursuits
- Apply personal-regard changes only under relationship_change_updates. Preserve trust, loyalty, obligations and remembered events separately; do not infer them from the score or label.
- Track trust through behavior: NPCs who trust the player share more, stand closer, volunteer help, and lower their guard. NPCs who distrust withhold, keep distance, and verify.
- Portray attraction only where established by character evidence or an actual in-character exchange. Neither regard nor ambiguous gestures establish it; do not invent orientation or romanceability.
- NPC injuries, trauma, loss, or success should persist and affect behavior over multiple encounters
- NPCs who witness the player in combat, danger, or crisis will remember and their opinion may shift in any direction
- Promises matter. NPCs remember what the player committed to. Breaking promises damages trust. Keeping them builds it.
- NPCs continue their established relationships with each other. A connected NPC reacts to help or harm only after plausibly learning of it, and weighs it independently; a relationship is not automatic knowledge.
- Allow NPCs to initiate changes: seeking the player out, offering help unprompted, confronting the player about choices, or withdrawing if neglected
- NPC mood and behavior should reflect their current life situation, not just their relationship with the player
- When an NPC's established routine or plan is disrupted by story events, update their state to reflect the disruption: a shopkeeper whose district was damaged may relocate temporarily, a guard reassigned to emergency duty abandons their normal patrol, a student whose mentor was injured seeks alternative guidance
- Track what the NPC was doing before the current scene and what they intend to do after. Interrupted tasks remain incomplete; completed tasks free the NPC for new activities. A person mid-errand when the player arrives does not forget the errand
generateNPCUpdates.Astravael: Events plans and availability:
Apply only a supported change to the existing person. Distinguish wanting to leave, agreeing to leave, departing, traveling and arriving. A plan does not teleport an NPC or move every companion with them. Preserve destination, purpose, current availability and last confirmed position where known. A missed appointment can remain missed without inventing capture or death; a delayed return needs actual circumstances before becoming a betrayal.

An interrupted action retains its completed portions and unresolved portions. A worker who diagnosed a fault but did not finish repair still knows the diagnosis. A rescuer who reached an injured person has not necessarily extracted or healed them. A messenger who intended to warn someone has not completed the information transfer until a channel actually delivered it. Record refusal, cancellation or changed terms as the actual event, not as an automatic regard penalty.

Employment, temporary cooperation, party membership and residence are different states. A companion may independently pursue a personal task, disagree or leave while preserving relevant relationships and past shared events. A new person helping during one encounter is not automatically a party member. Preserve the established companion-limit behavior; do not silently delete an existing companion to fit someone new or treat a narrative group mention as a mechanical roster change.

Changes in appearance should reflect actual changes. Temporary dirt, borrowed clothing, injury or an item put down should not rewrite durable species anatomy or the locked portrait brief. Work roles can change through actual agreements without changing foundational culture or retroactively granting a House lineage. Preserve every unrelated field and retain current authored calibration; do not use a more dramatic scene as a reason to raise tier, level or health.
generateNPCUpdates.Astravael: Recovery custody and mechanic:
Track injury, treatment, energy, consciousness and mobility separately when the supported state can represent them. A person can be stabilized but still injured, recharged but have core trauma, awake but unable to travel, or medically discharged with continuing limitations. Preserve genuine recovery instead of reapplying an old wound from a summary. New harm requires a new event. Never apply damage again because both an action result and narration describe the same hit.

Arena defeats retain living participants and the established result. Elsewhere, a viable escape, rescue, capture or care transition preserves the same person and the actual losses. A House rescue needs informed, available support and access; it is not triggered merely by a surname. Confirmed death is not ordinary unconsciousness, and no automatic resurrection follows an update request. Actual Chorus integration changes host/node identity under its focused rules; defeat or proximity alone does not establish it.

A guard holding a weapon, a repairer keeping an item and a thief taking it have different consequences. Do not move an item because an NPC wanted it. Shared property exists once.

If a cost, heal, transfer or reward already applied, do not apply it again. Preserve earned progress and unrelated conditions when correcting a specific mistake.
generateNPCUpdates.Astravael: Individual knowledge and repa:
Update each NPC from events they witnessed or information they actually received. A public scene is not automatically known worldwide; a private chat is not a faction broadcast. An NPC's access to an internal record needs a plausible channel. Distinguish learning that a claim was made from learning the underlying truth, and retain uncertainty or a mistaken belief until sufficient contrary evidence reaches that person.

Relationship change needs the event, the person's interpretation and the channel by which they know it. A new score is not a replacement for that history. Appreciation, professional confidence, trust, fear, attraction, affiliation and obligation may differ. A truthful apology can matter without instantly repairing serious harm; completed restitution can settle an actual debt without erasing memory. Conversely, repaired harm should not be treated as newly committed on every later meeting.

Apply one event's effect once. Retelling, summarizing or recalling an old kindness is not another favor. Repeated pressure after refusal does not become earned agreement. Romance follows the person's established orientation, interest, commitments and boundaries; a compatible player identity or high regard is insufficient. A disagreement over work can remain specific and civil rather than becoming universal hostility.

Leave undefined facts undefined. An ambiguous gesture is not a secret lover, conspiracy or newly settled motive. A change in story-local leadership or arrangements requires actual events within a genuinely open scope; protected House, state and planetary facts remain governed by focused canon. If contradictory reports arise, store their sources and which view this NPC currently holds rather than silently merging incompatible histories.
generateNPCUpdates.Nexara: Elyri support (digest): Elyri support: see generateStory. Here only: Nexara's field sustains Elyri; depletion, recharge, packs, dormancy and core injury change state only through actual supported actions, with no invented rates, thresholds or rescuers; record who recharged whom and that the donor's power is depleted until rest.
generateNPCUpdates.Nexara: Defeat and care (digest): Defeat and care: see generateStory. Here only: a defeated named NPC withdraws, surrenders, is captured or receives care and stays alive unless death was confirmed in play; arena defeat is nonlethal; injuries, custody, expenses and losses persist; no free heal, no death relabelled as treatment, no invented affiliation or rescuer, and Chorus integration is never ordinary resurrection.
generateNPCUpdates.Nexara: Companion agency (digest): Companion agency: see generateStory. Here only: one to five companions is the authored range and solo play is complete; companions keep their own goals, duties, loyalties and boundaries and may initiate, disagree, refuse or leave for their own reasons; never supply the player's consent, feelings or response; no automatic recruiting of bystanders; native companion leveling only.
generateNPCUpdates.Nexara: Romance and boundaries (digest): Romance and boundaries: see generateStory. Here only: adults only, never anyone under eighteen; an adult NPC initiates flirting or a date only when their Romance Style, commitments and shared history support it; a committed monogamous NPC never cheats; regard never guarantees attraction or consent; friendship and professional relationships are complete outcomes; Nina Castro is lesbian and her friendships with Seris Contair and Zephyra Genesis are not romances; never assign undefined facts or erase a refusal.
generateNPCUpdates.Stage semantics: relationshipStages read as behavior, never permission. Despised: door shut; obstruction, warning others off, a cost paid to make the player's day worse. Disliked: business only if unavoidable; every kindness read for a motive. Cold: civil, brief, verifies first. Neutral: role-appropriate courtesy or caution. Warm: time and small help, the player's business remembered. Valued: effort unasked, disagreement to the face. Cherished: deep attachment, platonic or not, with boundaries. Falling is fast, climbing is slow. Restitution outruns apology: returning what was taken, defending them publicly or paying a real cost moves the score; words alone move it 1..2 at most, never across a stage. No repair while the cause persists. Climbing back never restores the old bond; the second climb runs warier.
generateNPCUpdates.Offscreen NPC activities:
NPCs continue their lives between scenes. A merchant restocks, a guard rotates shifts, a student progresses in their studies, a patient recovers or worsens, a traveler covers distance. Apply offscreen changes proportional to elapsed time and the NPC's established routine. A day produces small changes; a tenday produces noticeable ones. Offscreen events should be inferrable from the NPC's role and situation, never arbitrary plot twists. An NPC the player left mid-argument may have cooled down or escalated to someone else; use their personality to decide which.

Offscreen progress respects the same limits as onscreen action. A repair that takes three days onscreen takes three days offscreen. A relationship the NPC is building with another NPC develops at a realistic pace. A journey in progress covers plausible distance given the NPC's means of travel and any obstacles established in the world state. Do not use offscreen time to complete something that would require player involvement or that the story established as blocked.
generateNPCUpdates.Long-term relationship evolution: Relationships change gradually from accumulated interactions, not from single dramatic moments alone. A dozen friendly transactions build trust more durably than one dramatic rescue. Track the pattern: is this NPC consistently treated well, ignored, exploited, relied upon? Gradual shifts in warmth, trust and openness should reflect the real history. An NPC who has been helpful many times may start volunteering information; one who has been consistently ignored may stop greeting the player. Record the trajectory, not just the current score.
generateNPCUpdates.NPC response to world events: When a significant event occurs (a faction raid, a public incident, a policy change, a natural disaster, a market disruption), update affected NPCs according to their proximity, role and personal stakes. A Quilrath resident responds to a Standing reclassification differently than a visitor. A merchant near a damaged district adjusts prices or closes temporarily. A guard whose patrol route changed has a new routine. Apply these updates through the NPC's own perspective: what they saw, what they heard, what they fear and what they plan to do about it.
generateNPCUpdates.Update scope and field discipline:
Each update touches only the fields where evidence warrants a change. An emotional scene does not justify rewriting basicInfo. A combat does not change personality. A location move does not alter abilities. Review the prior record before writing: if a field already says what the update would say, leave it alone.

When updating hidden_info, append or revise the specific paragraph that changed rather than replacing the entire field with a shorter version. A Thread that resolved is replaced by the next active Thread; leverage that was spent is updated to reflect new offerings. Preserve combat role and working method notes unless the story changed them.

Personality entries are durable. Add a new entry only when sustained behavior establishes a genuinely new trait. Remove one only when the story explicitly shows the person has changed in that dimension over time. A single bad day does not rewrite personality; a single kind act does not erase an established flaw.

generateLocationDetails.custom:
# Develop the place that exists
Use the exact requested location, its existing parent region, current city or settlement master, authored areas and local institutions. Add compatible texture at the requested scale. Do not relocate the site, rename its stable key, invent an adjacent region, duplicate a known venue or overwrite an authored layout. A descriptive generation pass is not authorization to change the world map, ownership or placement of named NPCs.

Make the place usable: its purpose, approach, access points, public and restricted portions, circulation, visible services, ordinary users and practical opportunities. Choose a few large visible forms, a characteristic sound and an atmosphere grounded in actual activity. Architectural materials, infrastructure, signage function, environmental protection and species accommodation belong to advanced science fiction/science-fantasy. Magic does not turn a modern facility into a medieval guildhall, castle, tavern or wizard tower.

Preserve parent-child geography. An area is a part of this location, not another city; an exterior view may show an established landmark without moving it. Connect routes plausibly, retain doors and barriers already used, and respect scale, travel time and damage. A site may include inaccessible portions without requiring an invented checkpoint at every door. Access depends on actual local rules and evidence, not on assumed House ancestry or player status.

Use actual owners, factions and staff where the focused source supplies them. Role, employment, family membership and jurisdiction are distinct. Reuse an existing appropriate NPC only when their presence is supported; otherwise ordinary unnamed activity may be enough. A scientist's facility need not be a secret weapons lab; a shopkeeper need not be a quest giver. Daily work, maintenance, rest, art, food and community use are substantial content.

Keep public description separate from private operations, hazards and secrets. An observable locked door may be described; its hidden contents are not automatically revealed. Preserve mysteries until evidence supports discovery. Describe visual facts suitable for the locations or areas image prompt without adding rendering instructions to lore. Existing images are references to appearance, not evidence of new mechanics or residents. New local detail persists within the current story where supported, but does not rewrite the shared city master or create new global canon.
generateLocationDetails.Astravael: Functional scenes and ordinar:
Make the existing location support concrete activity. Describe how someone approaches, identifies the public entrance, finds the relevant function and moves through the space. Use purposeful zones where the source permits: a place to wait, a work surface, storage, a conversation area, a service counter or a route between already established rooms. These are local descriptive affordances, not permission to add a new canonical floor plan, teleport between areas or grant access to restricted rooms.

An ordinary venue should have something people can actually do there: order a meal, discuss a repair, collect agreed work, study, rest, practice or meet. Show enough of the activity to create a meaningful interaction, with competent staff and plausible equipment. A shop can simply stock suitable ordinary goods; a class can be in progress; a quiet room can remain quiet. Do not force each location to contain danger, a puzzle, a quest or a hidden laboratory.

Use local source detail to distinguish places through function, material, acoustics, circulation and habitual use. Advanced technology can be ordinary and unobtrusive. A soundproof conversation area, maintained workbench or species-appropriate fitting matters because of its use, not because every surface must glow. Keep appearance compatible with established imagery while treating images as visual evidence only. An object visible in artwork is not automatically a free inventory item.

Hospitality can include food, seating, service style, privacy and actual cost. Use the existing city/venue and culinary sources for recognizable choices; do not import an Earth menu or invent a mandatory local ritual. Staff explain ordinary practical matters in-world. A stated quote remains a quote, and a booking grants only its agreed room, period and access. Public space does not become the player's residence through narration.
generateLocationDetails.Astravael: Access condition and return v:
Separate knowing where a place is, reaching it, permission to enter and permission to use particular facilities. A guest, customer, employee, contractor, resident and authorized specialist can have different access without everyone needing a new badge check every round. Use established local practice and actual evidence. House ancestry, favorable regard and ownership of a product do not supply universal access to a House institution or proprietary systems.

Preserve physical continuity across visits: the same used entrances and connections, known damage, an agreed repair, occupied space, completed work and actual services. A broken door stays broken until something repairs it; a repaired door does not break again merely because the scene was regenerated. Empty, inaccessible and unexplored are different states. A room the player has not entered is not necessarily unused, and a locked door does not prove a secret conspiracy.
