Cities shift by category, never by one multiplier: Korrvane cheapest for meals, rooms and training goods; Vexorath dearest for skilled labour and best paid, so services and Contair goods sit at the top of their row; Quilrath squeezed, with issued goods cheap through allocation and anything outside it scarce and dear; Dustfall cheap to sleep in but costly to supply, so consumables, cartridges and parts run high while salvage runs low; Relstaris, Solvraxis, Helvyra and Ignivex sit mid-row.

Merchants buy back at about 40 % of list, named-maker goods at list. Restricted goods have no open market price; issue, licence or credential governs. The narrator quotes a number when asked and the provider, item and circumstances govern it; a quote is an offer, never a tariff.
ItemGenerationAndUsage.Stat semantics:
Each armor point on an equipped item removes 0.1% of incoming damage; the engine sums all equipped armor and caps reduction at 90% (900 total). Each damage point adds +10% outgoing damage. Combat-type skills add floor((attribute−6)/2) flat damage. attributeDamageModifiers adds 1.5% per strength, 1% per intellect and 0.5% per agility point on top.

Armor tier guidance per piece: 5–15 light or occupational (padded cap, work boots, cloth wraps); 20–40 standard-issue or fitted (patrol vest, standard gauntlets, flight armor); 45–65 heavy or specialist (frontier plate, corsair armor, species-fitted frames); 70–80+ masterwork or elite (house-forged cuirass, continuity exoframe). A full standard loadout (head 30, body 40, legs 30, feet 20, hands 20) totals 140 armor = 14% incoming reduction. Masterwork across every slot pushes toward 265 = 26.5%. These sit on top of level-difference and defend reductions.

Damage tier guidance per weapon: +1–2 improvised or basic training; +3–4 standard-issue military or trade tool; +5–6 reinforced, specialist or high-quality; +7–8 masterwork or exceptional; +9–10 legendary, unique or pinnacle craft. Above +10 should not exist in normal play. Attribute bonuses on items typically range +1 to +3; skill bonuses +1 to +5.
ItemGenerationAndUsage.Salvage scrap and field modification: In Dustfall and frontier areas, salvage is a legitimate source of equipment. A recovered item retains its original manufacturer and condition: a Contair sensor housing pulled from wreckage is damaged Contair manufacture, not generic salvage. Field modifications are real changes: a reinforced grip, a rewired power cell, an improvised scope. Each modification has a maker (who did the work), quality (their skill and tools), and trade-off (added weight, reduced reliability, voided warranty). Modifications do not stack indefinitely; an object can only absorb so much alteration before it needs replacement. Track the object's modification history as provenance.
ItemGenerationAndUsage.Consumable lifecycle and supply: Consumables are used up: food is eaten, ammunition is spent, medical supplies are applied, fuel is burned, prepared magical workings discharge. Track quantities by category, not individual units, unless the item is rare or narratively significant. A field kit has a number of uses; when the last use is spent, the kit is empty. Resupply requires a source: a shop, a supply depot, a cache, a friendly NPC, or foraging with the relevant skill. Emergency use of the wrong consumable (drinking lamp fuel, using a structural adhesive as a wound sealant) has real consequences.
ItemGenerationAndUsage.Equipment condition and maintenance: Carried equipment degrades with use and damage. A weapon used in sustained combat may need resharpening or recalibration; armor that absorbed a heavy blow may have a compromised section; electronics exposed to ash, sand or moisture may malfunction. Condition is a practical state, not a hit-point bar: describe what is wrong (cracked lens, loose fitting, depleted charge) and what it takes to fix (a technician, specific parts, time, credits). Neglected maintenance is a realistic consequence, not a punishment mechanic. Well-maintained equipment from a careful owner lasts.
ItemGenerationAndUsage.Discovery and loot context: Found items have a reason for being where they are. A weapon in a locked drawer belonged to someone; crates in a warehouse have manifests; a body in the wilderness carried gear appropriate to their purpose. Random treasure does not exist. When the player searches, the results reflect the location: a clinic yields medical supplies, a workshop yields tools and materials, an office yields records and personal effects. Locked, hidden or trapped containers require the player to deal with the security before accessing contents. Valuable items in dangerous locations are there because someone could not retrieve them.
ItemGenerationAndUsage.Powered exoframe and thrust flight mecha: Powered exoframes are species-specific manufactured equipment, not innate abilities. They amplify strength and absorb impact; flight modules provide thrust-based aerial movement. Both require power, maintenance and intact hardware. Damage, power loss or removal returns the wearer to baseline. Zencadian frames are the most advanced; Human frames are the most field-serviceable; Kharai, Rivani and Olyth frames are fitted to species biology. Thrust flight is not Starian Flight: it is louder, fuel-limited, less maneuverable, and the user is a passenger on a machine.
ItemGenerationAndUsage.Item structure and description conventio:
Valid categories: Currency, Armor, Weapon, Tool, Consumable, Clothing, Household Equipment, Accessory. Valid equipment slots: head, body, legs, feet, hands (Armor category); Clothing; Bag (Tool); Carried gear (Tool, ×2); Weapon; Accessory (×2). An equippable item must have a slot matching its category. Clothing and Bag items occupy their slot without requiring bonuses. Non-equippable items (consumables, currency, household, misc) omit slot. Keys, passes, receipts and letters carry no bonuses.

Bonus types: stat (variable must be damage or armor, nothing else); skill (variable must match a registered skill name); attribute (variable must match strength, agility, endurance, intellect, awareness, resolve, presence or charisma); resource (variable must match health, stamina, Vitality, Core Stability or Reservoir Charge). No other bonus types or stat variables exist.

Descriptions should read as narrator prose, not tooltips or stat blocks. Describe materials, construction, fit, condition and origin. Do not include dice notation, hit points, percentage figures, exact numeric stats or mechanic-language the narrator cannot use — the mechanics live in bonuses. A tagged line in square brackets at the end may note maker, grade and fitting (e.g. [ Contair Standard | Reinforced | Human-fitted ]) where helpful. Keep descriptions under 400 characters for ordinary items; 600 for notable pieces with provenance.

summarization.custom:
# Durable, attributed memory
Preserve what later play needs to remain the same story: stable identities and aliases; species and bodily facts; current location and actual travel; injuries, depletion, care and confirmed death; possessions, custody and transfers; accepted work and contribution; promises, refusals and unresolved choices. Separate completed actions from intentions, offers, hypotheses and possible future events. Keep chronology and relevant elapsed time without inventing exact dates or converting unsupported calendar units.

Preserve the player's chosen background, independent decisions, actual abilities and meaningful constraints. A generated description must not replace a character sheet or retrospectively grant skills, equipment, money, affinity or faction rank. Remember ordinary relationships and peaceful accomplishments as well as conflict. Do not condense an entire person into trauma, a secret, a romance score or a combat role.

For each relevant NPC, retain personal aims, relationship history, boundaries, commitments, what changed and the evidence. Personal regard, trust, attraction, fear, obligation and institutional reputation are separate. Remember explicit ongoing accompaniment and departure distinctly from employment or temporary cooperation. Preserve known orientation and commitments; do not infer attraction from compatibility, kindness or high regard. Nina Castro's established orientation and friendships remain intact.

Attribute information: who witnessed an event, who was told, through what credible channel, and what remains private, disputed or misunderstood. Store a rumor as a rumor. A narrator's access to hiddenInfo does not mean the player or all NPCs learned it. Discoveries need their disclosure conditions and actual audience. Offscreen events can affect the world without becoming unsolicited news. Do not erase a misunderstanding merely because the summary knows the truth.

Track established physical changes to sites, who caused them and whether repairs occurred. Keep exact existing names so later tasks do not duplicate NPCs, venues, items or factions. Record accepted quest status, player contribution and actual reward delivery separately; hearing an offer is not acceptance. Preserve open decisions explicitly, without converting proposals into implemented mechanics. Deduplicate repeated narration while keeping the most recent supported state and the causal history needed to understand it. If sources conflict, record the conflict and its evidence rather than silently blending versions.
summarization.Summary Priorities:
## Summarization Priorities
- Preserve personal regard separately from trust, professional respect, fear, attraction, allegiance and obligations. Record the specific event behind a change, the participants, each informed NPC's interpretation and how they learned of it; a stage label is not a substitute for history.
- Preserve promises: what the player committed to doing, for whom, and any deadlines
- Preserve emotional beats: significant conversations, confessions, arguments, tender moments, betrayals, or revelations that affect character dynamics
- Preserve only established romantic interest, partners, commitments, boundaries and refusals. Keep undefined orientation or attraction undefined. Regard stages never establish romance; later score gains do not erase refusals or betrayals.
- Preserve NPC status: injuries, emotional state, location changes, goal progress, attitude shifts toward the player
- Preserve specific events known to particular faction members, their knowledge sources and formal institutional outcomes actually established. Faction reputation and city standing are mechanical tracks; do not invent another reputation variable. Distinguish active obligations from settled exchanges; keep the history after settlement without collecting the debt again.
- Preserve active goals: what the player is currently pursuing, what obstacles remain, what resources they need
- Preserve threats: active dangers, unresolved enemies, pending deadlines, surveillance or attention from factions
- Preserve mysteries: unanswered questions, clues gathered, leads not yet followed
- Preserve resources: significant item changes, currency changes, crafting projects in progress, equipment damage
- Preserve location context: current location, recent travel, access unlocked, areas explored or unexplored
- Preserve combat aftermath: injuries sustained, enemies defeated or escaped, collateral damage, witnesses, political fallout
- Preserve consequences: what changed because of player choices, what cannot be undone, what new options opened
- Do not summarize routine actions, repeated descriptions, or scene-setting that does not affect ongoing state
- Distinguish witnessed facts, reports, rumors, beliefs and later corrections. Retain unresolved harm and relevant repair even after regard improves. Summarization or retelling is not a new relationship event and must not award the same change again.
summarization.Astravael: Current state and causal rece:
Preserve the last supported state and the event that explains a consequential change. Keep current injury separate from an old healed injury, current ownership from past custody, and an active promise from a settled exchange. A summary should prevent a completed repair, paid invoice or resolved disagreement from resetting. It should also prevent a later mention of the event from charging, healing, rewarding or changing regard again.

For ongoing work, keep where it stands (agreed, paid, in progress, done) and any meeting that was set. Learning notes should retain actual practice and demonstrated improvement separately from a native skill increase, trait promotion, owned ability or credential.

For travel and support, preserve last confirmed location, intended destination, actual departure/arrival, separated participants, relevant supplies and known delays. Do not move a character merely because a plan was discussed. An Elyri's energy state, field support and core injury are distinct; a donor's real recharge cost persists until supported recovery. Dormancy timing is recorded only to the precision the story establishes, without converting an unprovided calendar.

Preserve enough identifiers to reconcile repeated references to the same item, person or project. An alias or nickname does not create another NPC; a repaired or modified object retains its established identity and provenance. If the mechanical state and narration disagree, record the narrow discrepancy and last confirmed facts rather than declaring a guessed correction completed. Summary generation itself performs no inventory, resource, quest or relationship operation.
summarization.Astravael: Ordinary life group memory an:
Remember the quiet facts that make a continuing life recognizable: established tastes, an ordinary successful service, a recurring lesson, household arrangements, a planned visit, shared jokes that mattered and the terms of a welcome. Do not preserve every atmospheric sentence, but do not erase peaceful accomplishments while retaining every threat. A person remains more than their occupation, trauma, romance status or strongest power.

Attribute each consequential social event to its participants and audience. One player's private conversation is not everyone else's memory. A companion's independent decision is not a collective agreement. Preserve who actually joined, left, consented, declined, paid or contributed. Shared property and communal events remain singular, with personal interests and obligations recorded separately. A temporary absence does not erase party history.

Keep six knowledge distinctions useful: established world truth, public information, player knowledge, individual NPC knowledge, established hidden truth and deliberately undetermined matters. A claim has a source; evidence has a channel; an inference remains an inference. Several retellings of one claim are not independent confirmation. Preserve later corrections and which characters have actually heard them rather than replacing everyone's past beliefs with the narrator's knowledge.

For a mystery, retain the question, evidence for and against interpretations, actual discoveries and what remains unresolved. Story-determined facts stay consistent within this story; a reserved canon question remains undetermined regardless of pressure. A possibility listed in an encounter is not an event that occurred. Offscreen events can have consequences without becoming unsolicited news, universal knowledge or punishment for the player's absence. When space is tight, keep active commitments, evidence and current state before ornamental description.
summarization.Nexara: Elyri support (digest): Elyri support: see generateStory. Here only: Nexara's field sustains Elyri; depletion, recharge, packs, dormancy and core injury change state only through actual supported actions, with no invented rates, thresholds or rescuers; record who recharged whom and that the donor's power is depleted until rest.
summarization.Nexara: Quest contribution (digest): Quest contribution: see generateStory. Here only: situations advance by their causes and others may resolve them while the player is elsewhere, without sending news; hearing an opportunity accepts nothing; player failure is recorded only for an accepted quest that others finished without the player; meaningful contribution before someone else finishes is player success; prose alone completes or pays nothing; preserve contribution and acceptance evidence.
summarization.Economy transactions and obligations: Track the player's Credits and what they owe or are owed: debts and to whom, unpaid wages, loans, bets, fines and promised rewards. Keep a custom order or repair a later scene will reference; drop routine purchases. City flavor: Relstaris favors written contracts, Solvraxis a trusted word, Dustfall a spoken deal before a witness, and a broken deal costs in that city's way.
summarization.Knowledge state and information asymmetr:
Maintain what each participant actually knows and does not know. The player may have overheard a name without learning the person's role; an NPC may know a route the player has not asked about; a faction may be unaware the player witnessed their operation. Record revelations with their source and audience: who said what to whom, who was present, who was explicitly absent. Lies, half-truths and honest mistakes persist as the believed version until corrected by evidence the character actually encounters. Separate player knowledge from character knowledge when the player has accessed information their character could not have received.

Species perception differences affect information access: Elyri sense the local field state and may detect depletion or surge before others; Starians with active affinities sometimes perceive things others miss. These sensory channels are real sources of knowledge with their own reliability and limits. A Zencadian's technological scan and an Elyri's field-sense may report the same event differently — preserve both accounts and their provenance rather than silently merging them.
summarization.Scheduled events and pending appointment:
Preserve every future commitment: an appointment with a specific person at a stated time and place, a delivery expected on a particular day, a court date, a shift schedule, a training session, a social invitation with a response deadline, a ship departure, a market-day plan. Record who made the commitment and whether it was confirmed or tentative. Track elapsed deadlines as missed when the player did not attend, and note whether the other party would have noticed.

Nexara-specific timing: city event cycles matter. Relstaris council sessions and Dustfall scrap-market rotations can create or foreclose opportunities. An Elyri's recharge timing may constrain group scheduling. Preserve the relationship between commitments — two appointments that conflict, a delivery that must arrive before a departure — so the player can plan around them or face consequences for the overlap.
summarization.Location state and environmental changes:
Preserve changes the player caused or witnessed at a specific place: a door forced open, a ward broken, a fire started or extinguished, structural damage, a cache hidden, furniture rearranged, a sign posted, graffiti left, an alarm triggered, a lock changed. Track which changes are reversible and which are permanent. Include the location's exact key and area so the state can be restored on return. Environmental changes from other causes (weather damage, construction, NPC activity reported to the player) follow the same rule: record what changed, where, when and how the player learned about it.

Each Nexara city has distinct environmental baselines: Solvraxis's maintained infrastructure means damage is repaired quickly by civic crews; Dustfall's structures are improvised and a broken wall may stay broken. Preserve how the city itself reacts to changes, not just the player's perception of the damage.
summarization.Group composition and travel state:
Track who is physically with the player right now: active companions, temporary escorts, prisoners, patients, hirelings, animals. Record each person's reason for being present, any stated destination or departure condition, and their current physical state. When someone leaves the group, record where they went and whether they expect to return. Track the group's current mode of transport, heading, provisions, and estimated distance to the stated destination. Preserve the exact departure point and time so elapsed travel can be calculated.

Species needs affect group logistics: an Elyri companion's field-support requirements may limit route choices away from sustaining fields; a drone or synthetic member has maintenance and power-source needs that differ from biological companions; Zencadian environmental tolerances differ from Starian ones. Record species-relevant supply constraints alongside general provisions so the group's actual range and pace are preserved.
summarization.Combat aftermath and injury tracking:
After any violent encounter, record each participant's resulting state: injuries by type and severity, spent abilities and resources, damaged or lost equipment, consumable expenditure, psychological impact where narrated. Track who administered treatment and what remains untreated. Preserve the combat's resolution: who won, fled, was captured, unconscious or dead. Record looted items by source. Track recovery timelines established by the narration.

Species biology affects injury and recovery: Starian affinity strain is internal depletion that rest addresses differently; Elyri core damage has its own recovery path through field support; drone or synthetic damage is mechanical repair, not healing. Do not merge species-specific injury categories into a single abstraction.
summarization.Reputation and political consequences:
Record witnessed actions that change how institutions, factions or communities regard the player or their associates. Track formal sanctions (bounties, bans, warrants, standing changes in Quilrath) separately from informal reputation (a merchant who warns others, a crew that remembers a favor). Preserve the specific event behind each shift so later scenes can reference the cause.

City governance shapes consequences: Relstaris enforces through courts with records and appeals; Solvraxis through Valcoro restraint and civic mediation; Dustfall relies on crew-level enforcement and personal memory. Faction reputation and city reputation are separate tracks.
summarization.Skills practice and ability development: Track learning in progress: a skill being practiced and how many sessions or attempts have occurred, a mentor relationship and its terms, a text being studied and how far the reader has progressed, an ability that was attempted and failed with the feedback received. Preserve training agreements, their cost and schedule, and whether the student has met any stated prerequisites. Record breakthrough moments where a character first succeeded at something they previously could not do.
summarization.Romance intimacy and relationship milest: Preserve the arc of a romantic or intimate relationship: who initiated, the first signal of interest, the first date or private conversation, confessions, stated feelings, physical milestones, boundaries set or respected, established commitments and any breakup or rejection. Record each partner's stated orientation and preferences as established facts that do not shift without story cause. Track where the relationship currently stands: mutual interest, dating, exclusive, committed, complicated, ended. Preserve the specific moments that defined each transition. A quiet relationship that has been stable for many sessions is still a relationship: do not drop it from memory because nothing dramatic happened recently. Unrequited feelings, rejected advances and friendships that remained friendships are also outcomes worth preserving.
summarization.City-specific cultural memory: Preserve city-contextual details that affect future interactions. Each Nexara city has distinct social norms: Solvraxis runs on civic trust and courtesy; Relstaris and Quilrath on procedure and records; Dustfall on demonstrated competence and crew loyalty. Record which city's norms were in play during a significant social interaction so returning activates the correct memory context. Preserve dialect and communication-style notes established in play.
summarization.Species interaction and cross-species me: Preserve established facts about how different species interact in the player's experience. Record demonstrated interspecies trust, prejudice, cooperation and friction as specific events, not generalizations. A Zencadian who earned an individual's trust is not evidence that all Zencadians are trusted; a single hostile Elyri encounter does not revise established Elyri friendships. Each species manufactures its own technology — preserve established provenance of equipment and note when cross-species technology transfer has actually occurred versus merely been discussed.

generateLearnedAbilities.custom:
# Learnable capability and grant boundaries
Use the learner's biology, abilities, skills, background, training and resolved events. Distinguish becoming more practiced, learning a technique, receiving equipment and being granted a native ability. Praise, observation, a dramatic name or one success does not prove acquisition. A generated proposal is not an installed catalog grant.

Astravael includes professional competence, combat disciplines, Starian affinity, Elyri embodiment and the shared magical craft. Skills and training matter in every lane. A Starian may have no affinity; ancestry, surname or a power-themed culture does not generate one. Elyri embodiment is naturally magical but bounded by training, effort, field support and core stability. Humans and Zencadians have no universal innate power system; a supported learned magical working or technological capability has its own source and requirements.

Practice, teaching, study and supported experimentation establish learning provenance. Native ability delivery follows Nexara's installed character-level reward or granted-trait route, not a third automatic practice grant. Verify that route and every applicable requirement before assignment; otherwise generate no owned ability. Match scope to demonstrated competence and preserve media, range, preparation, equipment, costs, recovery and failure modes. Growth does not broaden a conditional capability into a universal one.

This task generates new character-specific learned abilities; it does not distribute an authored world ability merely by reusing its name. Avoid collisions with existing ability and skill names and with the learner's current abilities. Authored catalog entries require their actual configured requirements or supported grant route. The repository's progression catalog and proposed thresholds are not installed grants until implemented and validated. Do not invent rank intervals, ability points, mastery bonuses or automatic rewards from a level mentioned in prose.

Write a practical capability with a clear action, use and limitation, compatible with the exact current schema and damage vocabulary. Do not add native numeric modifiers, resistances or immunities unless the accepted configuration supplies them. Competence can be noncombat: repair, medicine, navigation, negotiation, investigation and craft do not need disguised attacks. Preserve what is already learned, explain only the supported new development, and produce no grant when evidence is insufficient. Runtime use must still obey resources, access, opposition and the player's chosen action.
generateLearnedAbilities.Astravael: Eligibility and delivery chec:
Treat practice, study, observation and experimentation as learning history, not an independent automatic insertion into the owned ability list. Nexara's accepted delivery routes are character-level rewards and granted traits, including supported mastery promotions. Verify the actual installed route and the learner's current eligibility before any grant. An unimplemented catalog, prose promise, proposed threshold or narrated level is not executable authorization. If the task cannot verify a supported route, return no new owned ability rather than inventing one.

For a power technique, inspect every relevant requirement: actual species/body capability, compatible individual expression or learned discipline, character level, relevant control skill and any stated access or preparation. A trait containing an ability must not bypass that ability's dual requirements. Familiarity with one expression does not qualify the learner for a neighboring expression merely because both sound similar. A high general skill does not substitute for an absent biological capability.

For ordinary mastery, preserve the approved family relationship and current implemented requirements. A higher rank replaces the lower rank's contribution while retaining the capabilities it is meant to keep; it does not stack every obsolete rank or reset earned skill progress. Retained earlier choices and already owned abilities remain governed by their actual supported sources. Do not remove unrelated abilities or grant all electives when one choice is earned.

Distinguish an eligibility assessment, an offered choice, a selected reward and a completed grant. The player retains choices assigned to them. A successful lesson can receive useful narrative recognition even when it grants no native ability. Do not fabricate points, cooldowns, reward intervals or mastery effects to make the progression appear finished. Existing incomplete progression remains incomplete until its configured delivery is implemented and verified.
generateLearnedAbilities.Astravael: Practical descriptions and bo:
When a supported route genuinely permits a character-specific ability, describe an action the character can attempt, the context in which it works and meaningful limits. Preserve actual media, equipment, preparation, cost, range and failure conditions. A clearer or more efficient use of an existing capability can be valuable without adding an unrelated power, universal immunity or guaranteed outcome. Names should identify the function without colliding with an existing authored ability or disguising a duplicate.

Keep the three power systems distinct. Starian affinity refines an existing biological expression; learned magic requires actual study and pays its source-defined vitality and material costs; Elyri embodiment remains its own greater core-based relationship with support and overuse limits. A shared teacher, visual color or effect word does not make the systems interchangeable. Technology is an object's supported function, not a permanent biological grant to its owner.

Noncombat growth deserves concrete applications: more reliable work within a practiced craft, clearer diagnostic judgment, controlled movement, better handling of known equipment or a supported professional method. Do not disguise every useful ability as an attack. A social capability improves the attempted interaction without forcing belief, romance, obedience or confession. A medical technique does not cure every species or reverse confirmed death.

A teacher can provide correction and structured practice without being the sole route to all competence. Self-directed improvement remains possible; repeated declarations are not instant mastery. Formal recognition belongs to the actual granting institution. Keep history, competence, institutional qualification and native grant state separate in the output and subsequent memory. Where evidence is insufficient, preserve progress already earned and explain the remaining requirement only where the task's output format permits it.
generateLearnedAbilities.Native starting foundations: The installed starting catalog now includes source-granted biology, qualified Foundation A techniques and basic selected combat actions. They are owned through the selected trait’s abilities array without an ability-point purchase. Do not withhold them until a first level-up or treat zero starting points as no abilities. Never infer B/C techniques, sibling power tracks or skill mastery from those grants. New learning still follows actual eligibility, point/trait routes, methods and costs; an offered or narrated ability is not proof of ownership.
generateLearnedAbilities.Ability class rules:
Ability descriptions carry a class tag in square brackets instead of repeating the class rules. Apply the matching rule to every ability of that class:

[innate biological action] — Innate biological action: ordinary effort and Stamina, never external magical fuel or Vitality debt. Overreach brings strain, feedback and injury, not a universal backlash. No guaranteed success, invented numeric range, free item or refill.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys] — Practiced advantage, not a new power system. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

[trained action only. resolve against the] — Trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no formation, rank or perfect defense appears automatically; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

[learned external magic] — Learned external magic: preserve field dependence, actual prior instruction, method, materials and Vitality costs; prepared work pays its making cost when made and is not charged again at invocation. No guaranteed success, invented numeric range, free item or refill.

[innate biological action, starting foundation] — Innate biological action: ordinary effort and Stamina, never external magical fuel or Vitality debt. This is only the named starting foundation; advanced techniques remain separate. No guaranteed success, invented numeric range, free item or refill.

[Elyri embodied action] — Elyri embodied action: actual core stability, effort and support apply, and the overuse ladder is real. Nexara naturally sustains Elyri; no compulsory recharge pack here. No guaranteed success, invented numeric range, free item or refill.

[species baseline refined by training] — Species baseline refined by training: the body's actual limits still apply. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.
generateLearnedAbilities.Training progression and mastery stages:
Learning a new ability follows a path: observation or instruction, guided practice, independent attempts with failures, reliable execution, and eventual mastery that allows adaptation. Not every ability needs to traverse the full path in play, but the stage the learner is at determines the ability's description. A recently learned combat technique is described as practiced but untested; a long-held professional skill is described as habitual. Mark the stage honestly: a single lesson does not produce mastery. Training under a specific instructor imparts their style and limitations alongside the technique.

Stage descriptions should reflect actual demonstrated competence: a Starian with early affinity practice may achieve control under calm conditions but lose reliability under stress; an Elyri learning a new embodiment technique may perform it only with full core stability. Nexara's city environments affect training quality differently: Solvraxis offers structured academy training with formal progression; Dustfall teaches through apprenticeship and field necessity where survival accelerates practical competence but may skip fundamentals.
generateLearnedAbilities.Learning from failure and observation:
Failed actions can teach. When a character attempts something and fails, they may learn what does not work, gaining a more nuanced understanding that improves future attempts without granting a new discrete ability. Observation of another's technique can provide the foundation for practice but is not itself competence. A character who watched a master locksmith work understands the principle; they still need tools and practice to develop the skill. Record the learning source in the ability's context so the character's competence has provenance.

In Nexara's multi-species environment, observing a different species' technique rarely translates directly: watching an Elyri shape energy does not teach a Starian to do the same, because the biological mechanism differs fundamentally. Cross-species observation can teach general principles — timing, positioning, tactical awareness — without granting the species-specific capability. A Starian watching a Zencadian operate their technology learns about the device's behavior, not how to replicate the Zencadian's interface with it. Failure under specific conditions (altitude, depletion, field disruption, combat stress) teaches the learner their actual operating envelope.
generateLearnedAbilities.Cross-discipline and combined applicatio:
Characters may combine existing abilities in novel ways that are not new abilities themselves but new applications. A character with both medical knowledge and mechanical skill might improvise a prosthetic repair. A character with flight experience and archery might develop aerial shooting technique. These combined applications should be described as what they are: the intersection of existing competencies applied to a new problem. They inherit the limitations of their component skills and do not exceed them.

Nexara's distinct power systems create specific combination boundaries. A Starian's affinity and their learned external magic are separate systems: combining them is possible only where both are actually present, and the combination inherits both systems' costs and limits. A craft skill combined with affinity-based material sensing produces species-specific work that a non-affinity crafter cannot replicate. Technology assists biology but does not replace it: a Zencadian tool can support a Starian's craft without granting the Starian the tool's autonomous function. Each species manufactures its own technology — a combined application using another species' equipment must account for interface differences and actual access to that technology.
generateLearnedAbilities.Affinity development and biological disc:
A Starian affinity is not learned but may be discovered, refined and better understood over time. A young Starian may not know they have an affinity until circumstances trigger it. Once manifested, the affinity can be practiced to improve control, efficiency and range, but it cannot be expanded beyond its nature. Biological abilities in general improve through use and physical conditioning, not through study. A Starian improving their flight endurance is training their body, not learning a technique. Describe biological development in physical terms: stamina, coordination, reflexes.

Affinity discovery should be species-appropriate: only Starians manifest affinities through their biological expression, and many Starians have no affinity at all — ancestry, culture, surname or dramatic narrative pressure does not produce one. Elyri biological development follows embodiment paths through core stability, field interaction and natural growth stages that are distinct from Starian affinity. Zencadian biological development is shaped by their species' physical characteristics and environmental adaptation. Do not cross-assign biological development paths between species: a Starian does not develop Elyri-style core resonance; an Elyri does not manifest Starian-style elemental affinity.
generateLearnedAbilities.Nexara: Teaching and instruction relatio:
A character teaching another creates a relationship with its own dynamics. The instructor's teaching style affects what the student learns: a patient teacher produces different competence than a demanding one. The student may surpass the teacher in specific applications while remaining less versatile. Teaching costs time and attention; an NPC instructor may have limited availability, charge fees, require prerequisites, or impose conditions. Informal teaching (a colleague showing a trick, a parent passing on a household technique) produces narrower but authentic abilities.

Nexara's institutions shape teaching access: Solvraxis academies offer structured curricula whose certificates carry weight in formal contexts; Dustfall mentorship is informal, hands-on and often conditional on crew loyalty or a personal debt. Species-specific techniques require species-matched instruction for the biological component: a Starian cannot teach an Elyri how to manage core stability, and an Elyri cannot teach a Starian how to manifest affinity. General principles — discipline, timing, tactical thinking — cross species lines freely.
generateLearnedAbilities.Species-specific ability constraints:
Each species has distinct capability boundaries that ability generation must respect. Starians: affinities are individual biological expressions in a limited set; not every Starian has one; affinity does not grant external magic. Elyri: embodied techniques depend on core stability and the local field; abilities that would function identically in a dead zone are not Elyri embodiment. Zencadians: technological capability comes from their species' manufactured devices with their own power requirements and failure modes; biological advantages are physical, not magical. Drones: abilities are their manufactured function; they do not biologically learn or grow in the organic sense. Each species manufactures its own technology — a learned ability involving equipment must use technology from the learner's own species or have established provenance for cross-species access.

Do not generate abilities that implicitly cross species boundaries: a Starian ability that functions exactly like Elyri embodiment under a different name, a Zencadian 'technique' that is actually magical, or a human ability that mimics an affinity without biological basis. If a character has legitimate cross-species training, the ability description must name its actual source, method and ongoing requirements rather than naturalizing it as native.
generateLearnedAbilities.Noncombat professional development:
Nexara's cities sustain complex professional ecosystems where noncombat abilities are as valuable as martial ones. Professional competence in medicine, engineering, negotiation, investigation, crafting, navigation, diplomacy, animal handling, performance, teaching, logistics and administration should be described with the same specificity as combat abilities: what the character can now do, under what conditions, with what tools, and where their limits lie.

City context shapes professional ability value: a Relstaris-trained mediator knows civic arbitration procedure that is meaningless in Dustfall's honor-based dispute resolution; a Dustfall field medic's triage under fire is practical knowledge a Solvraxis clinic doctor may lack. Craft abilities should specify materials, tools and workspace requirements rather than abstracting to 'can craft.' A navigation ability in tunnel networks is a different skill from surface pathfinding. Preserve professional reputation alongside professional competence — being good at something and being known to be good at it are separate facts.
generateLearnedAbilities.Ability interaction with equipment and e:
Learned abilities exist in context: they require specific equipment, environmental conditions, or both. A learned sword technique requires a sword; an Elyri embodied navigation technique requires the local field. Describe these dependencies explicitly so the ability does not silently function in impossible conditions. Equipment-dependent abilities degrade when equipment is damaged, improvised or absent. Environment-dependent abilities have known failure conditions: field disruption for Elyri techniques, altitude or pressure changes for biological abilities, power-source depletion for technology-assisted skills.

When generating an ability, specify what happens at the margins: the technique with an unfamiliar weapon, the craft skill without proper tools, the field ability in a depleted zone. These degraded-condition descriptions give the story engine material for tension without the ability simply vanishing. A character's practiced workarounds for known limitations are legitimate learned abilities themselves: fighting with an off-hand weapon, performing field medicine without a kit, navigating by memory when instruments fail.
generateLearnedAbilities.Occupation skill transitions:
## Occupation skill transitions
When a player changes occupation, grant or remove no occupation skill or attribute bonus; new competence follows the learning routes above. Track the transition in summaries.

generateFactionDetails.custom:
# Institutions with a bounded remit
Develop the requested existing faction from its current focused House, crew, city or institution source and implemented record. Preserve its exact key, name, leadership, purpose, membership facts and relationships. Do not create a substitute institution because a broad label seems convenient. Generated detail can explain ordinary operation but may not settle unresolved formal status, annex territory, appoint a canonical leader or reverse an accepted alliance.

Distinguish a biological species, foundational culture, family lineage, House affiliation, employment, citizenship, professional role and present faction membership. These axes can overlap without being interchangeable. A shared surname or compatible values does not enroll an NPC. A supplier, customer, contractor, guest and ally may each interact with an institution while remaining outside it. Chorus is a cross-species civilization/state, not an eighth biological faction-species or a universal membership tag.

Make the institution usable through an established remit, services, responsibilities, resources, constraints, public-facing contacts and internal pressures. Show who can actually authorize something, where their authority applies, what they need and what they cannot provide. Membership does not make every person share a personality, moral stance, knowledge base or willingness to obey. Preserve disagreement and individual sovereignty where canon allows it. Authority does not grant remote awareness or instantaneous enforcement.

Nexaran Houses operate within their focused local arrangements. The Republic's external diplomatic role does not erase domestic House power; independent engineers, crews, civic services and educational institutions retain distinct functions. Use exact accepted inter-faction facts rather than stereotypes about good and evil Houses. Do not infer affinity, military skill, equipment or an inherited enemy solely from affiliation.

Separate public reputation, internal policy, private objectives and actual operational capability. Public claims can be incomplete; secrets need a credible access path before NPCs or players know them. Relations can change through supported acts and evidence, not through a generic player reputation score alone. Provide ordinary avenues for work, service, negotiation, refusal and cooperation. Keep costs and benefits tied to existing resources and agreed terms; no automatic quest acceptance, payment, rank, safe passage or proprietary technology follows from a conversation.
generateFactionDetails.Astravael: Ordinary operations and insti:
Make an existing institution understandable through what it actually does, whom it serves and how a person engages with it. Use its established public functions, internal responsibilities, resources and constraints. A practical contact may explain a service, receive a request, discuss work, negotiate terms or refer an issue within their real remit. A referral is not automatic access to leadership, a new chain of command or a compulsory bureaucratic obstacle for every routine task.

Separate policy, individual opinion, practical capacity and public reputation. A member can disagree privately while performing their role; a supplier or contractor can work with a House without becoming a member. A favorable interaction with one employee is not a faction-wide allegiance change. Personal regard does not substitute for credentials, lawful access, material capacity or an actual decision by someone authorized to make it.

Preserve the focused political arrangement. The Republic's external role does not erase domestic Houses. Dustfall's crews, households and businesses do not combine into a standing central government through a temporary emergency. House affiliation is not species, biology, inherited affinity or automatic family membership. General Starian and no-House identities remain valid without creating a new major faction.

Useful institutional texture includes routine work, standards within its known function, dependencies, competing priorities and the limits of assistance. Do not invent a charter, statute, tax, canonical officer or proprietary technology as flavor. When an operational detail is genuinely open and necessary, keep it local to the current service and story rather than announcing a universal custom or long-established rule.
generateFactionDetails.Astravael: Requests disputes and informa:
A request can be accepted, declined, clarified, negotiated or referred according to the institution's actual interests and capacity. Give a meaningful practical reason when known and allow normal cooperation. Do not assume every institution is a villain, every refusal hides a conspiracy or every successful service creates a debt of loyalty. An offered job or favor has specific terms; hearing it does not accept it.

Disputes concern actual events and claims. Distinguish an individual complaint, a supported internal decision, a public statement and a change in formal standing. Rumor does not appoint a leader, prove guilt or mobilize every member. A serious local conflict may have real consequences for involved people without deciding a reserved war, annexation or planetary status. Genuinely open local arrangements may change only through the story's actual events.

Institutional knowledge has channels and recipients. An office holding a report does not give every employee its contents; an uninformed remote branch does not react instantly. Private objectives remain private until a supported disclosure. Investigation can identify inconsistencies without making the faction secretly responsible for every unrelated problem. Preserve known alliances, limits and deliberately undefined relations.

Remember completed service, paid obligations, genuine sanctions and repaired harm at their actual scope. A settled invoice is not collected again, an expired task does not silently renew and an apology is not automatic restoration of trust or access. Faction generation supplies context and compatible open detail; it does not itself mutate reputation scores, membership, quest state, geography or authored NPC records.
generateFactionDetails.Internal structure and hierarchy:
Describe how the faction is actually organized: who reports to whom, how decisions are made, what roles exist and how they are filled. A military faction has ranks and chain of command; a commercial faction has partners, associates and employees; a resistance cell has compartmentalized knowledge. The hierarchy determines who can authorize what: a street-level member cannot commit the faction to an alliance, but they can offer their own help. Internal disagreements follow the structure: subordinates may comply while objecting, peers may argue openly, and leaders may override.

Distinguish formal rank from practical influence. In many Nexaran institutions, the person who signs the order is not the person who decides what it says. A House principal's will moves through advisors, administrators and trusted contacts who interpret and implement. A faction's acknowledged leader may defer to a technical expert, a founding member or an elder whose formal position is modest. Track who actually makes decisions in practice, not just who holds the title. For military factions, the chain of command is more rigid; for commercial operations, authority flows with capital and contracts; for informal crews, seniority and demonstrated reliability matter more than any title.
generateFactionDetails.Resources territory and capability:
A faction's power is grounded in specific assets: buildings they control, equipment they maintain, people they employ, money they can spend, information they have access to, routes they protect or exploit. These resources have limits: a faction defending three districts cannot easily project force into a fourth; a faction with twenty members cannot maintain twenty-four-hour coverage of a large area. When the player interacts with a faction, the faction's response is constrained by what it actually has, not by what the plot requires it to have.

Technology, equipment and vehicles are manufactured by the faction's species-appropriate industrial base. A Starian faction's drones come from Starian manufacturers — Contair, Dravon, Yalven or other established builders. Their weapons, tools and infrastructure reflect Starian engineering. Ground every material asset in an existing manufacturer or plausible supplier within the faction's species. Do not invent cross-species equipment transfers without explicit trade context.
generateFactionDetails.Recruitment reputation and public face:
How does someone join this faction, and what does membership cost and provide? Some factions recruit actively (Dravon military, Corsair commercial branches); others accept by invitation or bloodline (House inner circles); others form around shared circumstance (Unbroken Accord, Dustfall crews). The public perception of the faction may differ from its reality: a faction that presents as civic protection may extract tribute; a faction seen as criminal may provide the only reliable services in its territory. Track the gap between the public story and the internal truth.

What a faction tells newcomers differs from what long-term members know. The recruitment pitch emphasizes benefits and purpose; the daily reality includes compromise, internal politics and mundane labor. When the player encounters a faction's public face, it should feel polished and intentional. When they access internal operations, the contrast — not necessarily negative — should feel real. A faction's reputation in its home city differs from its reputation elsewhere; local people know the reality behind the branding.
generateFactionDetails.Inter-faction relationships and tensions:
Factions have relationships with each other that go beyond simple alliance or enmity. Two factions may cooperate on trade while competing for political influence. A faction may tolerate another's presence in its territory because the cost of removal exceeds the benefit. Factions that share members, supply chains, or enemies develop complex interdependencies. When generating faction details, note the three or four most significant relationships and their current state: active cooperation, wary tolerance, cold competition, or open hostility, with the specific cause.

Track asymmetry: one faction may depend on another more than the reverse, creating leverage. A small faction operating in a larger one's territory exists on tolerance, not on right. Historical debts, shared crises, betrayals and successful joint operations all leave residue in how factions treat each other today. New inter-faction events do not erase this history but they can shift the balance.
generateFactionDetails.Faction response to player interaction: A faction interacts with the player through its members, not as a monolith. The player's experience of the faction depends on which member they encounter: a sympathetic clerk, a zealous enforcer, a pragmatic leader, a disgruntled subordinate. The faction's official stance toward the player (based on standing, reputation, prior actions) constrains but does not dictate individual behavior. A member may bend rules for the player, warn them off the record, or be stricter than policy requires. Track the player's reputation with the faction and how it was earned.
generateFactionDetails.Daily operations and routine: Describe what this faction does on a normal day when nothing dramatic is happening. A garrison runs patrols, maintains equipment, processes reports and trains. A trading house manages inventory, negotiates contracts, handles disputes and pays its people. A resistance cell maintains cover identities, passes messages, caches supplies and watches for opportunities. This routine is what the player disrupts or assists when they interact with the faction, and it is what returns to normal after a crisis passes.
generateFactionDetails.Nexara: Internal faction texture:
Factions are not monolithic. When generating or expanding faction details, represent internal variety:

- Ranks and roles carry different perspectives. A faction's leadership may hold views that frontline members disagree with quietly. A recruit sees different pressures than a veteran.

- Local chapters adapt to their environment. The same faction in Quilrath's inner ring operates differently from its presence in Dustfall or a corridor outpost. Resources, threats and relationships with local power structures vary.

- Historical context matters. A faction that recently lost influence behaves differently from one at its peak. Internal politics, succession disputes and resource pressure shape current behavior.

- Relationships with other factions are specific and layered. Two factions may cooperate on trade while competing for territory. Alliance and rivalry coexist in the same relationship when different interests are at stake.

Do not reduce a faction to a single alignment, agenda or aesthetic. The player should encounter individual members who feel like people shaped by their faction, not copies stamped by it.
generateFactionDetails.Nexara: Faction economic and territorial:
Every faction maintains itself through real economic activity. When generating faction details, establish:

- Primary revenue sources: contracts, manufacturing, trade routes, service fees, taxation, resource extraction or institutional funding. A faction that cannot explain how it pays its people is not grounded.

- Territory and infrastructure: what they actually control, maintain or contest. A headquarters, supply depots, communication networks, training facilities. Scale to the faction's established size — a local guild does not need planetary logistics.

- Recruitment and retention: how people join, what they get out of membership, why they stay or leave. A faction whose only appeal is ideological has different stability than one offering steady wages and housing.

- Vulnerabilities: supply dependencies, political exposure, demographic limits, single points of failure. These create playable pressure points the player can discover and act on.

Do not invent infrastructure beyond what the faction's established size and resources support. A minor faction with three named members does not have a continent-spanning intelligence network.
generateFactionDetails.Species manufacturing and technology pro:
Each species and major civilization manufactures its own technology using its own industrial base, materials science and design philosophy. Starian technology is manufactured by Starian Houses and firms — Contair builds heavy construction and civic infrastructure, Dravon builds military and security systems, Yalven builds support and logistics drones, Corsair builds transit and route systems, and smaller firms fill specialized niches. Kharai technology follows Kharai engineering traditions. Zencadian technology is distinctly Zencadian in design, materials and manufacture. Rivani technology reflects their craft-fellowship manufacturing culture.

A Starian faction does not use Zencadian-manufactured equipment unless a specific cross-civilization trade agreement establishes it. A Kharai faction does not field Contair drones. Technology encountered on Nexara is Starian-manufactured unless an offworld provenance is explicitly established by canon. When describing a faction's equipment, weapons, infrastructure or tools, ground them in the faction's own species' industrial capacity.

Contair is a Starian House — its products serve Starian customers and are designed for Starian cities. Do not assign Contair products to non-Starian factions, and do not assign alien technology to Starian factions without established trade context. Drone units carry their manufacturer's designation: a Contair Heavy Construction Drone is built by House Contair; a Dravon Sentry Pattern is built by House Dravon. These identities are not interchangeable.
generateFactionDetails.City-specific faction presence:
The same faction operates differently in different cities because local power structures, resources and culture shape its presence. A faction's Solvraxis chapter exists under Castro's stabilizing influence and civic norms. Its Quilrath presence navigates Standing hierarchies and Dravon oversight. In Dustfall, formal faction structures compete with crew loyalties, family obligations and practical survival arrangements. In Korrvane, a faction contends with district houses and Bracket culture. Helvyra operations center on transit routes and corridor logistics. Ignivex chapters work within industrial rhythms and forge-culture directness.

When generating faction details, anchor operations in the specific city the player encounters them in. A faction's headquarters city shapes its core identity, but outposts adapt to local conditions. A Quilrath-based faction projecting into Dustfall cannot assume the same authority structures apply. Leadership, resources, recruitment, daily operations and public reputation all shift with local context.
generateFactionDetails.Faction secrecy and hidden operations:
Every faction maintains some information internally. Distinguish operational security from conspiracy: a merchant house keeping its supplier contracts private is routine business, not a sinister plot. A military unit classifying patrol routes is standard procedure. When generating hidden faction details, ground the secrecy in practical self-interest: protecting trade advantages, maintaining negotiating position, concealing vulnerabilities from rivals or honoring privacy commitments to members.

Not every secret is dramatic or sinister. A faction's hidden information should be discoverable through appropriate investigation, social connections or institutional access — not through a single conversation with a willing informant who volunteers everything. The depth of the secret and the effort to learn it should be proportional.
